source_text: Nakipag-ugnayan ang mga regional partner sa pamamagitan ng Changi RHCC [Changi Regional HADR Coordination Centre] nang sabay-sabay dumating ang maraming alok ng suporta.
target_text: Regional partners coordinated through the Changi RHCC [Changi Regional HADR Coordination Centre] when multiple offers of support arrived at once.

source_text: Humiling ang apektadong pamahalaan ng heavy-lift support mula sa US INDOPACOM [United States Indo-Pacific Command] para sa mga nakahiwalay na komunidad sa bundok.
target_text: The affected government requested heavy-lift support from US INDOPACOM [United States Indo-Pacific Command] for isolated mountain communities.

source_text: Nilinaw ng liaison note mula sa PLA [People's Liberation Army] kung paano dapat pagsunod-sunurin ang mga alok ng partner bago lumipat ang suporta ng partner patungo sa northern communes.
target_text: A liaison note from PLA [People's Liberation Army] clarified how partner offers should be sequenced before partner support moved toward the northern communes.

source_text: Nakatulong ang mga situation update mula sa AHA Centre [ASEAN Coordinating Centre for Humanitarian Assistance on disaster management] na ihanay ang mga prayoridad sa relief sa buong ASEAN partners.
target_text: Situation updates from the AHA Centre [ASEAN Coordinating Centre for Humanitarian Assistance on disaster management] helped align relief priorities across ASEAN partners.

source_text: Sumali ang mga ministryo ng pamahalaan at humanitarian agencies sa coordination call na pinangunahan ng UN OCHA [United Nations Office for the Coordination of Humanitarian Affairs].
target_text: Government ministries and humanitarian agencies joined the coordination call hosted by UN OCHA [United Nations Office for the Coordination of Humanitarian Affairs].

source_text: Sa nasirang distrito, bineripika ng ASEAN-ERAT [ASEAN Emergency Response and Assessment Team] ang mga pangangailangan sa silungan bago ipadala ang karagdagang supplies.
target_text: In the damaged district, ASEAN-ERAT [ASEAN Emergency Response and Assessment Team] verified shelter needs before additional supplies were dispatched.

source_text: Itinala ng tasking board ang ACMC [Australian Civil-Military Centre] bilang pangunahing contact sa koordinasyon para sa shelter support sa mountain road corridor.
target_text: The tasking board recorded ACMC [Australian Civil-Military Centre] as the key coordination contact for shelter support in the mountain road corridor.

source_text: Iniugnay ng mga opisyal ng distrito ang ToR [Terms of Reference] sa binagong distribution window matapos magbago magdamag ang mga ulat mula sa mga hamlet sa river-island.
target_text: district officers linked ToR [Terms of Reference] to a revised distribution window after reports from river-island hamlets changed overnight.

source_text: Hiniling ng health cluster sa WHO [World Health Organization] na repasuhin ang disease surveillance plan.
target_text: The health cluster asked WHO [World Health Organization] to review the disease surveillance plan.

source_text: Nakipag-ugnayan ang mga lokal na awtoridad sa WFP [World Food Programme] upang maghatid ng food packages sa evacuation centres.
target_text: Local authorities coordinated with WFP [World Food Programme] to deliver food packages to evacuation centres.

source_text: Inilapat ng mga logistics clerk ang ToR [Terms of Reference] nang ang mapanganib na debris malapit sa isang bodega ay nagpagawang hindi gaanong predictable ang pagpaplano para sa lugar ng bodega ng probinsiya.
target_text: logistics clerks applied ToR [Terms of Reference] when unsafe debris near a warehouse made planning for the provincial warehouse area less predictable.

source_text: Nirepaso ng USAID BHA [United States Agency for International Development, Bureau for Humanitarian Assistance] ang emergency shelter grants sa donor coordination meeting.
target_text: Emergency shelter grants were reviewed by USAID BHA [United States Agency for International Development, Bureau for Humanitarian Assistance] during the donor coordination meeting.

source_text: Tinalakay ng mga regional defence official ang kahandaan sa HADR sa ilalim ng balangkas ng ADMM-Plus [ASEAN Defence Ministers' Meeting Plus].
target_text: Regional defence officials discussed HADR readiness under the ADMM-Plus [ASEAN Defence Ministers' Meeting Plus] framework.

source_text: Idinagdag ang mga aral mula sa EWG on HADR [Experts' Working Group on Humanitarian Assistance and Disaster Relief] sa exercise evaluation matrix.
target_text: Lessons from the EWG on HADR [Experts' Working Group on Humanitarian Assistance and Disaster Relief] were added to the exercise evaluation matrix.

source_text: Sinuri ng lider ng rescue team ang patnubay ng INSARAG [International Search and Rescue Advisory Group] bago magtalaga ng search sectors.
target_text: The rescue team leader checked INSARAG [International Search and Rescue Advisory Group] guidance before assigning search sectors.

source_text: Ipinadaan ang meeting notes sa ASEAN Secretariat [Central administrative body for ASEAN] para sa opisyal na distribusyon.
target_text: Meeting notes were routed through the ASEAN Secretariat [Central administrative body for ASEAN] for official distribution.

source_text: Kinatalogo ng AMRG on HADR [ASEAN Militaries Ready Group on HADR] ang mga deployable medical at engineering unit.
target_text: Deployable medical and engineering units were catalogued by the AMRG on HADR [ASEAN Militaries Ready Group on HADR].

source_text: Humiling ang host nation ng suporta sa water purification mula sa SAF [Singapore Armed Forces] matapos makontamina ang mga balon.
target_text: The host nation requested water purification support from SAF [Singapore Armed Forces] after wells were contaminated.

source_text: Itinalaga ang engineering equipment mula sa PLA [People's Liberation Army] upang ibalik ang akses sa tawiran ng ilog.
target_text: Engineering equipment from the PLA [People's Liberation Army] was assigned to restore access to the river crossing.

source_text: Inikoordina ang pang-araw-araw na regional tasking sa pamamagitan ng JOCCA [Joint Operations and Coordination Centre of ASEAN] sa kasagsagan ng panahon ng pagtugon.
target_text: Daily regional tasking was coordinated through JOCCA [Joint Operations and Coordination Centre of ASEAN] during the peak response period.

source_text: Ipinakita ng SCDF [Singapore Civil Defence Force] ang collapsed-structure search procedures sa field drill.
target_text: Collapsed-structure search procedures were demonstrated by SCDF [Singapore Civil Defence Force] during the field drill.

source_text: Iniulat ng national command post ang lahat ng internasyonal na alok sa VINASARCOM [Vietnam's National Steering Committee for Civil Defense].
target_text: The national command post reported all international offers to VINASARCOM [Vietnam's National Steering Committee for Civil Defense].

source_text: Hinubog ng mga prayoridad sa flood defence mula sa VDDMA [Vietnam Disaster and Dyke Management Authority] ang alokasyon ng pumps at sandbags.
target_text: Flood defence priorities from VDDMA [Vietnam Disaster and Dyke Management Authority] shaped the allocation of pumps and sandbags.

source_text: Ibinigay ng mga engineer ng VPA [Vietnam People's Army] ang suporta sa pagkukumpuni ng tulay matapos bumagsak ang main supply route.
target_text: Bridge repair support was provided by VPA [Vietnam People's Army] engineers after the main supply route failed.

source_text: Nagbigay-impormasyon ang agricultural loss data mula sa MARD [Ministry of Agriculture and Rural Development] sa pagpaplano ng early recovery.
target_text: Agricultural loss data from MARD [Ministry of Agriculture and Rural Development] informed early recovery planning.

source_text: Idinagdag ang mga update sa road clearance mula sa MOT [Ministry of Transport] sa common operating picture.
target_text: Road clearance updates from MOT [Ministry of Transport] were added to the common operating picture.

source_text: Inaprubahan ng MOH [Ministry of Health] ang mga prayoridad sa medical evacuation bago lumipad ang mga helicopter.
target_text: Medical evacuation priorities were approved by MOH [Ministry of Health] before helicopters launched.

source_text: Tinukoy ng recovery partners sa ilalim ng DRRP [Vietnam Disaster Risk Reduction Partnership] ang priority communes para sa resilience programming.
target_text: Recovery partners under DRRP [Vietnam Disaster Risk Reduction Partnership] identified priority communes for resilience programming.

source_text: Naabot ng preparedness messaging na sinuportahan ng QPT [Community Fund for Natural Disaster Prevention] ang mga sambahayan sa mga lugar na madaling tamaan ng landslide.
target_text: Preparedness messaging supported by QPT [Community Fund for Natural Disaster Prevention] reached households in landslide-prone areas.

source_text: Tumulong ang mga first aid team mula sa VNRC [Vietnam Red Cross] sa matatandang evacuee sa school shelter.
target_text: First aid teams from VNRC [Vietnam Red Cross] assisted elderly evacuees at the school shelter.

source_text: Ibinahagi ang hospital readiness reports mula sa VAMS [Vietnam Administration of Medical Service] sa evening health briefing.
target_text: Hospital readiness reports from VAMS [Vietnam Administration of Medical Service] were shared during the evening health briefing.

source_text: Ginamit ng operational handover ang format na WoG [Buong Pamahalaan] upang pagsamahin ang mga update ng baybaying distrito mula sa transport, health, at defence officials.
target_text: The operational handover used a WoG [Whole-of-Government] format to combine coastal district updates from transport, health, and defence officials.

source_text: Naghintay ang mga internasyonal na partner sa NDMO [National Disaster Management Office] na kumpirmahin ang opisyal na listahan ng pangangailangan.
target_text: International partners waited for the NDMO [National Disaster Management Office] to confirm the official needs list.

source_text: Nang magkasalungat ang mga update mula sa provincial capital, binigyan ng CMCoord [Civil-Military Coordination] ang mga planner ng mas malinaw na paraan upang ihambing ang mga prayoridad.
target_text: When updates from the provincial capital conflicted, CMCoord [Civil-Military Coordination] gave planners a clearer way to compare priorities.

source_text: Nirepaso ng mga planner ang Mil-Mil [Koordinasyong Militar-sa-Militar] bago magtalaga ng responsibilidad para sa relief distribution sa morning coordination cycle.
target_text: Planners reviewed Mil-Mil [Military-to-Military coordination] before assigning responsibility for relief distribution during the morning coordination cycle.

source_text: Nirepaso ng response team ang Civ-Mil [Koordinasyong Sibilyan-Militar] matapos ilantad ng nasirang radio repeater ang kahinaan sa pagpaplano para sa temporary bridge site.
target_text: The response team reviewed Civ-Mil [Civilian-Military coordination] after a damaged radio repeater exposed a weakness in planning for the temporary bridge site.

source_text: Nang mag-ulat ang mga public health team ng high tide malapit sa bukana ng ilog, naging sanggunian ang AS [Affected State] para sa mas makitid na search area.
target_text: When public health teams reported high tide near the river mouth, AS [Affected State] became the reference point for a narrower search area.

source_text: Ibinigay ng MNCC [Multi-National Coordination Centre] ang nawawalang konteksto matapos kuwestiyunin ng mga assessment lead ang mga ulat mula sa hill road bypass.
target_text: MNCC [Multi-National Coordination Centre] provided the missing context after assessment leads questioned reports from the hill road bypass.

source_text: Nakarating ang mga ulat ng distrito sa EOC [Emergency Operations Centre] bago nagsimula ang national briefing.
target_text: District reports reached the EOC [Emergency Operations Centre] before the national briefing began.

source_text: Nagsumite ang probinsiya ng RFA [Request for Assistance] para sa water treatment units at mobile medical teams.
target_text: The province submitted an RFA [Request for Assistance] for water treatment units and mobile medical teams.

source_text: Idinagdag ang shelter occupancy figures sa COP [Common Operating Picture] bago ang update ng mga commander.
target_text: Shelter occupancy figures were added to the COP [Common Operating Picture] before the commanders' update.

source_text: Muling binalikan ng pangkat ang SAR [Search and Rescue] dahil nakaapekto ang kakulangan ng ambulance crews sa paraan ng pagpaplano ng donor representatives ng mas maikling commander update.
target_text: The team revisited SAR [Search and Rescue] because a shortage of ambulance crews affected how donor representatives planned a shorter commander update.

source_text: Kinailangan ng gumuhong apartment block ng karagdagang USAR [Urban Search and Rescue] dogs at technical search equipment.
target_text: The collapsed apartment block required additional USAR [Urban Search and Rescue] dogs and technical search equipment.

source_text: Nirepaso ng response team ang AS [Affected State] matapos ilantad ng nasirang radio repeater ang kahinaan sa pagpaplano para sa northern evacuation belt.
target_text: The response team reviewed AS [Affected State] after a damaged radio repeater exposed a weakness in planning for the northern evacuation belt.

source_text: Bago nagsimula ang debris clearance, sinuri ng responders kung may mga panganib na CBRE [Epekto ng Kemikal, Biyolohikal, Radiological, at Paputok].
target_text: Before debris clearance began, responders checked whether CBRE [Chemical, Biological, Radiological, and Explosive impact] hazards were present.

source_text: Nang lumitaw ang mga pagguho ng lupa sa itaas ng bypass, nakipagtulungan ang PLA [People's Liberation Army] sa mga rescue supervisor sa mas maliit na assessment team sa low-lying market town.
target_text: When mudslides above the bypass emerged, PLA [People's Liberation Army] worked with rescue supervisors on a smaller assessment team in a low-lying market town.

source_text: Pinagsama sa ilalim ng WASH [Tubig, Sanitasyon, at Kalinisan] ang emergency latrines at malilinis na water points sa sector plan.
target_text: Emergency latrines and clean water points were grouped under WASH [Water, Sanitation, and Hygiene] in the sector plan.

source_text: Itinala ang kumot, sleeping mats, at kitchen sets bilang stocks ng NFI [Mga Hindi Pagkaing Item].
target_text: Blankets, sleeping mats, and kitchen sets were recorded as NFI [Non-Food Items] stocks.

source_text: Nagbigay ang HOC [Humanitarian Operations Centre] ng nakatuong update tungkol sa pinsala sa tulay, na tumulong sa pangkat na ayusin ang mga prayoridad para sa pansamantalang staging base.
target_text: HOC [Humanitarian Operations Centre] contributed a focused update on bridge damage, which helped the team adjust priorities for the temporary staging base.

source_text: Iniulat ng mga warehouse manager ang kakulangan sa gasolina at trak sa LCC [Logistics Coordination Centre].
target_text: Warehouse managers reported fuel and truck shortages to the LCC [Logistics Coordination Centre].

source_text: Muling binalikan ng pangkat ang COP [Common Operating Picture] dahil nakaapekto ang baradong culvert malapit sa MSR sa paraan ng pagpaplano ng mga warehouse manager ng balanseng tala ng prayoridad ng sektor.
target_text: The team revisited COP [Common Operating Picture] because a blocked culvert near the MSR affected how warehouse managers planned a balanced sector priority note.

source_text: Umakyat ang hospital drill sa isang MASCAS [Mass Casualty Incident] scenario na may simulated trauma patients.
target_text: The hospital drill escalated into a MASCAS [Mass Casualty Incident] scenario with simulated trauma patients.

source_text: Nakinabang ang mga papasok na rescue team sa Mutual Recognition [Kasunduan sa sertipikasyon para sa mga USAR team] sa proseso ng deployment.
target_text: Incoming rescue teams benefited from Mutual Recognition [Certification agreement for USAR teams] during the deployment process.

source_text: Dumaan ang relief cargo sa APOD [Aerial Port of Disembarkation] bago ito dalhin sa loob ng lupain gamit ang trak.
target_text: Relief cargo moved through the APOD [Aerial Port of Disembarkation] before being trucked inland.

source_text: Inilipat ng logistics team ang heavy equipment sa pamamagitan ng SPOD [Sea Port of Disembarkation] upang bawasan ang siksikan sa airfield.
target_text: The logistics team shifted heavy equipment through the SPOD [Sea Port of Disembarkation] to reduce airfield congestion.

source_text: Muling binuksan ng mga engineer ang MSR [Main Supply Route] na nag-uugnay sa bodega ng probinsiya sa evacuation area.
target_text: Engineers reopened the MSR [Main Supply Route] linking the provincial warehouse to the evacuation area.

source_text: Nakumpleto ng mga papasok na responder ang CIQ [Customs, Immigration, at Quarantine] checks bago lumipat sa staging base.
target_text: Incoming responders completed CIQ [Customs, Immigration, and Quarantine] checks before moving to the staging base.

source_text: Tinanggap ng pamahalaan ang suporta ng MCDA [Military and Civil Defence Assets] para sa transport, engineering, at medical evacuation.
target_text: The government accepted MCDA [Military and Civil Defence Assets] support for transport, engineering, and medical evacuation.

source_text: Pinrotektahan ang mga prayoridad na makatao sa pamamagitan ng paggamit ng HuMOCC [Humanitarian-Military Operational Coordination Concept] bilang sanggunian sa koordinasyon.
target_text: Humanitarian priorities were protected by using HuMOCC [Humanitarian-Military Operational Coordination Concept] as the coordination reference.

source_text: Bumuo ang pulisya, forensic specialists, at health staff ng DVI [Disaster Victim Identification] coordination group.
target_text: Police, forensic specialists, and health staff formed the DVI [Disaster Victim Identification] coordination group.

source_text: Ipinaalam ng mga lider ng baryo sa LEMA [Local Emergency Management Authority] na naubusan ng inuming tubig ang isang silungan.
target_text: Village leaders informed LEMA [Local Emergency Management Authority] that one shelter had run out of drinking water.

source_text: Nagsanay ang mga kalahok sa Ex COORES [Exercise Coordinated Response] ng decision-making sa ilalim ng makatotohanang panrehiyong disaster scenario.
target_text: Participants in Ex COORES [Exercise Coordinated Response] practiced decision-making under a realistic regional disaster scenario.

source_text: Inilapat ng mga liaison officer ang TTX [Table-Top Exercise] nang ang hindi tiyak na road weight limits ay nagpagawang hindi gaanong predictable ang pagpaplano para sa lugar ng bodega ng probinsiya.
target_text: liaison officers applied TTX [Table-Top Exercise] when uncertain road weight limits made planning for the provincial warehouse area less predictable.

source_text: Nirepaso ng response team ang OPERA CIS [Computer Information System para sa pagbabahagi ng impormasyon] matapos ilantad ng grupo ng mga kaso ng lagnat ang kahinaan sa pagpaplano para sa nasirang ferry crossing.
target_text: The response team reviewed OPERA CIS [Computer Information System for information sharing] after a cluster of fever cases exposed a weakness in planning for the damaged ferry crossing.

source_text: Sinuri ng mga opisyal ang SASOP [Standard Operating Procedures for Regional Standby Arrangements] bago humiling ng regional standby assets.
target_text: Officials checked SASOP [Standard Operating Procedures for Regional Standby Arrangements] before requesting regional standby assets.

source_text: Nirepaso ang deployment ng military assets laban sa SASOP Chapter VI [Seksyong namamahala sa pagpapadali at paggamit ng military assets] habang nasa scenario.
target_text: Military asset deployment was reviewed against SASOP Chapter VI [Section governing facilitation and utilization of military assets] during the scenario.

source_text: Binanggit ng legal advisor ang AADMER [ASEAN Agreement on Disaster Management and Emergency Response] habang ipinapaliwanag ang mga mekanismo ng ASEAN disaster response.
target_text: The legal advisor cited AADMER [ASEAN Agreement on Disaster Management and Emergency Response] when explaining ASEAN disaster response mechanisms.

source_text: Inangkop ng scenario design team ang isang ARDEX [ASEAN Regional Disaster Emergency Response Simulation Exercise] inject para sa flood response exercise.
target_text: The scenario design team adapted an ARDEX [ASEAN Regional Disaster Emergency Response Simulation Exercise] inject for the flood response exercise.

source_text: Nagbabala ang logistics SME [Subject Matter Expert] na maaaring maging bottleneck ang daungan sa loob ng ilang oras.
target_text: The logistics SME [Subject Matter Expert] warned that the port could become a bottleneck within hours.

source_text: Sa AAR [After Action Review], nabanggit ng mga kalahok na kailangan ng mga liaison officer ng mas malinaw na handover notes.
target_text: During the AAR [After Action Review], participants noted that liaison officers needed clearer handover notes.

source_text: Ang mga ulat na ginawa gamit ang GenAI [Generative AI] ay nangangailangan pa rin ng pagsusuri ng human operational staff.
target_text: Reports drafted with GenAI [Generative AI] still required review by human operational staff.

source_text: Isinama sa evening update ang PLA [People's Liberation Army] dahil nakaapekto ang community feedback sa lokal na pagpaplano at panrehiyong koordinasyon.
target_text: The evening update included PLA [People's Liberation Army] because community feedback affected both local planning and regional coordination.

source_text: Nakatulong ang mga flood map na hinango mula sa Sentinel-1 [Programa ng satellite imaging] upang kumpirmahin kung aling mga kalsada ang nadaraanan pa.
target_text: Flood maps derived from Sentinel-1 [Satellite imaging program] helped confirm which roads were still passable.

source_text: Inayos ang timeline ng pagtugon sa paligid ng Copernicus [Programa ng satellite imaging] matapos maapektuhan ng pinsala sa tulay ang mga komunidad sa mga baryo sa ibaba ng agos.
target_text: The response timeline was adjusted around Copernicus [Satellite imaging program] once bridge damage affected communities in the downstream villages.

source_text: Nirepaso ng response team ang Digital Twin [Iminungkahing virtual replica project para sa katumpakan ng simulation] matapos ilantad ng nawawalang beneficiary list ang kahinaan sa pagpaplano para sa remote commune assembly point.
target_text: The response team reviewed Digital Twin [Proposed virtual replica project for simulation accuracy] after a missing beneficiary list exposed a weakness in planning for the remote commune assembly point.

source_text: Binanggit ng coordination brief ang mga input mula sa MOT [Ministry of Transport] matapos baguhin ng pagkawala ng telekomunikasyon ang mga palagay sa pagtugon.
target_text: The coordination brief cited inputs from MOT [Ministry of Transport] after telecommunications outages changed the response assumptions.

source_text: Ginamit ng planning cell ang Interoperability [Kakayahan ng iba't ibang sistema na magpalitan ng data] upang magpasya kung kailangan ng mga baybaying baryo ng mangingisda ng mas simpleng decision brief.
target_text: The planning cell used Interoperability [Ability of different systems to exchange data] to decide whether coastal fishing villages needed a simpler decision brief.

source_text: Para sa upland landslide corridor, binigyan ng Information Overload [Hamon ng pamamahala sa malaking dami ng data sa kasagsagan ng epekto] ang pangkat ng paraan upang ihambing ang kakulangan ng ambulance crews sa iba pang panganib sa pagtugon.
target_text: For the upland landslide corridor, Information Overload [Challenge of managing high data volumes during peak impact] gave the team a way to compare a shortage of ambulance crews with other response risks.

source_text: In-update ng coordination cell ang ToR [Terms of Reference] matapos dumating ang mga bagong liaison officer.
target_text: The coordination cell updated its ToR [Terms of Reference] after new liaison officers arrived.

source_text: Ipinaliwanag ng commander ang CONOPS [Concept of Operations] bago magtalaga ng mga gawain sa partner units.
target_text: The commander briefed the CONOPS [Concept of Operations] before assigning tasks to partner units.

source_text: Ipinadaan ang bawat alok ng tulong sa NFP [National Focal Point] bago tanggapin.
target_text: Every offer of assistance was routed through the NFP [National Focal Point] before acceptance.

source_text: Inilapat ng mga liaison officer ang HADR [Tulong na Makatao at Pagtugon sa Sakuna] nang ang grupo ng mga kaso ng lagnat ay nagpagawang hindi gaanong predictable ang pagpaplano para sa eastern hospital catchment.
target_text: liaison officers applied HADR [Humanitarian Assistance and Disaster Relief] when a cluster of fever cases made planning for the eastern hospital catchment less predictable.

source_text: Kumonsulta ang mga opisyal ng distrito sa Changi RHCC [Changi Regional HADR Coordination Centre] habang pinag-uugnay ang mga ulat sa silungan sa mga hadlang sa akses sa nasirang lugar ng daungan.
target_text: District officials consulted Changi RHCC [Changi Regional HADR Coordination Centre] while reconciling shelter reports with access constraints in the damaged port area.

source_text: Bago aprubahan ang susunod na support package, hiniling ng mga planner sa US INDOPACOM [United States Indo-Pacific Command] na kumpirmahin kung saan kailangang ayusin ang timing ng distribusyon.
target_text: Before approving the next support package, planners asked US INDOPACOM [United States Indo-Pacific Command] to confirm where distribution timing needed adjustment.

source_text: Nilinaw ng liaison note mula sa CFE-DM [Center for Excellence in Disaster Management and Humanitarian Assistance] kung aling mga kahilingan ang napatunayan bago lumipat ang partner support patungo sa floodplain settlements.
target_text: A liaison note from CFE-DM [Center for Excellence in Disaster Management and Humanitarian Assistance] clarified which requests were validated before partner support moved toward the floodplain settlements.

source_text: Isinama sa evening update ang AHA Centre [ASEAN Coordinating Centre for Humanitarian Assistance on disaster management] dahil nakaapekto ang hindi tiyak na paggalaw ng populasyon sa lokal na pagpaplano at panrehiyong koordinasyon.
target_text: The evening update included AHA Centre [ASEAN Coordinating Centre for Humanitarian Assistance on disaster management] because uncertain population movement affected both local planning and regional coordination.

source_text: Matapos mag-ulat ang field teams ng siksikan sa mga silungan, tumulong ang UN OCHA [United Nations Office for the Coordination of Humanitarian Affairs] na pinuhin ang support request para sa northern communes.
target_text: After field teams reported shelter crowding, UN OCHA [United Nations Office for the Coordination of Humanitarian Affairs] helped refine the support request for the northern communes.

source_text: Sumali ang ASEAN-ERAT [ASEAN Emergency Response and Assessment Team] sa talakayan upang beripikahin kung binago ng naantalang relief flights ang assessment schedule.
target_text: ASEAN-ERAT [ASEAN Emergency Response and Assessment Team] joined the discussion to validate whether delayed relief flights had changed the assessment schedule.

source_text: Kumonsulta ang mga opisyal ng distrito sa ACMC [Australian Civil-Military Centre] habang pinag-uugnay ang mga ulat sa silungan sa mga hadlang sa akses sa provincial capital.
target_text: District officials consulted ACMC [Australian Civil-Military Centre] while reconciling shelter reports with access constraints in the provincial capital.

source_text: Isinama ng mga lider ng komunidad ang PDC [Pacific Disaster Center] sa talakayan dahil kailangan ng industrial estate na nasira ng baha ng mas maliit na assessment team.
target_text: community leaders brought PDC [Pacific Disaster Center] into the discussion because the flood-damaged industrial estate needed a smaller assessment team.

source_text: Nilinaw ng liaison note mula sa WHO [World Health Organization] kung aling mga kahilingan ang napatunayan bago lumipat ang partner support patungo sa nasirang lugar ng daungan.
target_text: A liaison note from WHO [World Health Organization] clarified which requests were validated before partner support moved toward the damaged port area.

source_text: Inayos ng WFP [World Food Programme] ang iskedyul ng paghahatid ng pagkain matapos gawing masyadong siksikan ng flight delays ang airfield para sa karaniwang cargo movement.
target_text: WFP [World Food Programme] adjusted the food delivery schedule after flight delays made the airfield too congested for routine cargo movement.

source_text: Matapos mag-ulat ang field teams ng community feedback, tumulong ang ISCG [Intersectoral Coordination Group] na pinuhin ang support request para sa floodplain settlements.
target_text: After field teams reported community feedback, ISCG [Intersectoral Coordination Group] helped refine the support request for the floodplain settlements.

source_text: Isinama ng mga planner ang USAID BHA [United States Agency for International Development, Bureau for Humanitarian Assistance] sa talakayan nang magsimulang makaapekto ang hindi tiyak na paggalaw ng populasyon sa susunod na relief movement.
target_text: Planners brought USAID BHA [United States Agency for International Development, Bureau for Humanitarian Assistance] into the discussion once uncertain population movement began affecting the next relief movement.

source_text: Kumonsulta ang mga opisyal ng distrito sa ADMM-Plus [ASEAN Defence Ministers' Meeting Plus] habang pinag-uugnay ang mga ulat sa silungan sa mga hadlang sa akses sa northern communes.
target_text: District officials consulted ADMM-Plus [ASEAN Defence Ministers' Meeting Plus] while reconciling shelter reports with access constraints in the northern communes.

source_text: Ang update mula sa EWG on HADR [Experts Working Group on Humanitarian Assistance and Disaster Relief] ay nagbigay sa mga logistics clerk ng sapat na detalye upang makagawa ng binagong distribution window para sa lugar ng bodega ng probinsiya.
target_text: The update from EWG on HADR [Experts Working Group on Humanitarian Assistance and Disaster Relief] gave logistics clerks enough detail to produce a revised distribution window for the provincial warehouse area.

source_text: Nilinaw ng liaison note mula sa INSARAG [International Search and Rescue Advisory Group] kung aling mga kahilingan ang napatunayan bago lumipat ang partner support patungo sa provincial capital.

source_text: Hinubog ng OPERA CIS ang praktikal na gawain sa suplay ng tubig matapos kumpirmahin ng shelter supervisors ang kalagayan sa downstream irrigation zone.
target_text: OPERA CIS shaped a practical water-supply task once shelter supervisors confirmed conditions in the downstream irrigation zone.

source_text: Ginamit ng planning cell ang AS [Affected State] upang magpasya kung kailangan ng port access road ng mas makatotohanang gawaing pang-inhinyeriya.
target_text: The planning cell used AS [Affected State] to decide whether the port access road needed a more realistic engineering task.

source_text: Para sa southern resettlement area, binigyan ng SASOP Chapter VI ang pangkat ng paraan upang ihambing ang limitadong availability ng forklift sa iba pang panganib sa pagtugon.
target_text: For the southern resettlement area, SASOP Chapter VI gave the team a way to compare limited forklift availability with other response risks.

source_text: Binanggit ng coordination note ang AADMER matapos ilantad ng kakulangan sa gasolina ang puwang sa proseso ng pagtugon.
target_text: The coordination note referenced AADMER after fuel shortages exposed a gap in the response process.

source_text: Inilapat ng logistics clerks ang AS [Affected State] nang ang magkakasalungat na bilang ng populasyon ng baryo ay nagpagawang hindi gaanong predictable ang pagpaplano para sa lugar ng bodega ng probinsiya.
target_text: logistics clerks applied AS [Affected State] when conflicting village population figures made planning for the provincial warehouse area less predictable.

source_text: Inayos ang timeline ng pagtugon sa paligid ng SME matapos makaapekto ang ambulance backlogs sa mga komunidad sa mountain road corridor.
target_text: The response timeline was adjusted around SME once ambulance backlogs affected communities in the mountain road corridor.

source_text: Sa coastal fishing villages, tumulong ang AAR na gawing mas mabilis na customs package ang mapanganib na debris malapit sa isang bodega.
target_text: In coastal fishing villages, AAR helped convert unsafe debris near a warehouse into a faster customs package.

source_text: Sa health coordination update, hinubog ng AS [Affected State] kung paano inayos ng mga pangkat ang mga ulat mula sa downstream villages.
target_text: During the health coordination update, AS [Affected State] shaped how teams organized reports from the downstream villages.

source_text: Isinalin ng LLM ang maiikling operational updates para sa liaison officers bago idagdag ng information team ang mga ito sa COP.
target_text: The LLM translated short operational updates for liaison officers before the information team added them to the COP.

source_text: Ginamit ng planning cell ang Sentinel-1 upang magpasya kung kailangan ng low-lying market town ng mas malinaw na medical referral plan.
target_text: The planning cell used Sentinel-1 to decide whether a low-lying market town needed a clearer medical referral plan.

source_text: Para sa school shelter cluster, binigyan ng Copernicus ang pangkat ng paraan upang ihambing ang limitadong availability ng forklift sa iba pang panganib sa pagtugon.
target_text: For the school shelter cluster, Copernicus gave the team a way to compare limited forklift availability with other response risks.

source_text: Inilahad ng coordination brief ang tambak ng relief cargo sa pamamagitan ng Digital Twin upang maaprubahan ng mga lider ang praktikal na gawain sa suplay ng tubig.
target_text: The coordination brief framed a backlog of relief cargo through Digital Twin so leaders could approve a practical water-supply task.

source_text: Muling binalikan ng pangkat ang Hybrid Exercise dahil nakaapekto ang mga pagguho ng lupa sa itaas ng bypass sa paraan ng pagpaplano ng provincial planners ng mas makatotohanang gawaing pang-inhinyeriya.
target_text: The team revisited Hybrid Exercise because mudslides above the bypass affected how provincial planners planned a more realistic engineering task.

source_text: Sa port access road, tumulong ang Interoperability na gawing mas simpleng decision brief ang pansamantalang rasyon ng gasolina.
target_text: In the port access road, Interoperability helped convert a temporary fuel ration into a simpler decision brief.

source_text: Hinubog ng Information Overload ang mas malinaw na medical referral plan matapos kumpirmahin ng shelter supervisors ang kalagayan sa southern resettlement area.
target_text: Information Overload shaped a clearer medical referral plan once shelter supervisors confirmed conditions in the southern resettlement area.

source_text: Nilinaw ng ToR kung sino ang maaaring humiling ng updates, magsama-sama ng priorities, mag-apruba ng task changes, at magbigay ng briefing sa leadership.
target_text: The ToR clarified who could request updates, consolidate priorities, approve task changes, and brief leadership.

source_text: Nakatulong ang maikling pagsusuri ng CONOPS sa medical planners na bigyang-kahulugan ang baradong culvert malapit sa MSR nang hindi naaantala ang mas makitid na search area.
target_text: A short review of CONOPS helped medical planners interpret a blocked culvert near the MSR without delaying a narrower search area.

source_text: Iniugnay ng public health teams ang AS [Affected State] sa mensahe ng babala sa lokal na wika matapos magbago magdamag ang mga ulat mula sa mga hamlet sa river-island.
target_text: public health teams linked AS [Affected State] to a local-language warning message after reports from river-island hamlets changed overnight.

source_text: Muling binalikan ng pangkat ang HADR dahil nakaapekto ang nawawalang beneficiary list sa paraan ng pagpaplano ng community leaders ng nakatuong pagbisita sa silungan.
target_text: The team revisited HADR because a missing beneficiary list affected how community leaders planned a targeted shelter visit.

source_text: Hiniling ng mga opisyal ng distrito sa Changi RHCC na beripikahin ang mga pagguho ng lupa sa itaas ng bypass bago maglaan ng resources sa lugar ng bodega ng probinsiya.
target_text: district officers asked Changi RHCC to verify mudslides above the bypass before committing resources to the provincial warehouse area.

source_text: Nirepaso ng response team ang AS [Affected State] matapos ilantad ng pansamantalang rasyon ng gasolina ang kahinaan sa pagpaplano para sa nasirang ferry crossing.
target_text: The response team reviewed AS [Affected State] after a temporary fuel ration exposed a weakness in planning for the damaged ferry crossing.

source_text: Nagbigay ang CFE-DM ng nakatuong update tungkol sa pagkawala ng telekomunikasyon, na tumulong sa pangkat na ayusin ang mga prayoridad para sa forward logistics hub.
target_text: CFE-DM contributed a focused update on telecommunications outages, which helped the team adjust priorities for the forward logistics hub.

source_text: Nang lumitaw ang naantalang bridge inspection, nakipagtulungan ang AHA Centre sa rescue supervisors sa mas mabilis na customs package sa airport cargo apron.
target_text: When a delayed bridge inspection emerged, AHA Centre worked with rescue supervisors on a faster customs package in the airport cargo apron.

source_text: Para sa downstream irrigation zone, binigyan ng AS [Affected State] ang pangkat ng paraan upang ihambing ang baradong culvert malapit sa MSR sa iba pang panganib sa pagtugon.
target_text: For the downstream irrigation zone, AS [Affected State] gave the team a way to compare a blocked culvert near the MSR with other response risks.

source_text: Itinala ng tasking board ang ASEAN-ERAT bilang pangunahing contact sa koordinasyon para sa babala sa komunidad sa downstream villages.
target_text: The tasking board recorded ASEAN-ERAT as the key coordination contact for community warning in the downstream villages.

source_text: Bago lumipat ang suporta patungo sa industrial estate na nasira ng baha, tinulungan ng ACMC ang community leaders na ikumpara ang overloaded reception desk sa field reports.
target_text: Before support moved toward the flood-damaged industrial estate, ACMC helped community leaders check an overloaded reception desk against field reports.

source_text: Sa western logistics corridor, tumulong ang AS [Affected State] na gawing mas makatotohanang gawaing pang-inhinyeriya ang mapanganib na debris malapit sa isang bodega.
target_text: In the western logistics corridor, AS [Affected State] helped convert unsafe debris near a warehouse into a more realistic engineering task.

source_text: Nagbigay ang WHO ng nakatuong update tungkol sa pinsala sa tulay, na tumulong sa pangkat na ayusin ang mga prayoridad para sa mga pamayanan sa isla.
target_text: WHO contributed a focused update on bridge damage, which helped the team adjust priorities for the island communities.

source_text: Nakipag-ugnayan ang shelter supervisors sa WFP matapos magbanta ang mapanganib na debris malapit sa isang bodega na gambalain ang suporta para sa western logistics corridor.
target_text: shelter supervisors coordinated with WFP after unsafe debris near a warehouse threatened to disrupt support for the western logistics corridor.

source_text: Iniugnay ng information managers ang AS [Affected State] sa binagong distribution window matapos magbago magdamag ang mga ulat mula sa temporary bridge site.
target_text: information managers linked AS [Affected State] to a revised distribution window after reports from the temporary bridge site changed overnight.

source_text: Para sa upland landslide corridor, ginamit ng warehouse managers ang input mula sa USAID BHA upang pumili ng mas malinaw na medical referral plan sa halip na malawak na tugon.
target_text: For the upland landslide corridor, warehouse managers used inputs from USAID BHA to choose a clearer medical referral plan instead of a broad response.

source_text: Isinama ng transport officials ang ADMM-Plus sa talakayan dahil kailangan ng low-lying market town ng mas maikling commander update.
target_text: transport officials brought ADMM-Plus into the discussion because a low-lying market town needed a shorter commander update.

source_text: Iminungkahi ng EWG on HADR ang isang drill sa hinaharap na nakatuon sa customs clearance at airfield reception constraints.
target_text: The EWG on HADR suggested a future drill focused on customs clearance and airfield reception constraints.

source_text: Nakatulong ang patnubay ng INSARAG sa host nation na pamahalaan ang maraming rescue teams na dumarating na may magkakaibang equipment packages.
target_text: INSARAG guidance helped the host nation manage multiple rescue teams arriving with different equipment packages.

source_text: Iningatan ng ASEAN Secretariat ang mga tala ng pulong upang marepaso ang mga susunod na aksyon sa susunod na siklo ng pagpaplano.
target_text: The ASEAN Secretariat preserved meeting records so follow-up actions could be reviewed during the next planning cycle.

source_text: Sinuri ng mga planner ng AMRG on HADR kung kayang ipagpatuloy ng deployable forces ang operasyon nang hindi dinaragdagan ang pasanin ng apektadong estado.
target_text: AMRG on HADR planners examined whether deployable forces could sustain operations without burdening the affected state.

source_text: Ibinahagi ng SAF planners ang mga aral tungkol sa cargo prioritization kapag nagsasabay ang humanitarian flights, evacuations, at assessment missions.
target_text: SAF planners shared lessons on cargo prioritization when humanitarian flights, evacuations, and assessment missions overlap.

source_text: Nakipag-ugnayan ang PLA engineers sa local authorities tungkol sa site access requirements bago simulan ang temporary bridge assessment.
target_text: PLA engineers coordinated site access requirements with local authorities before beginning a temporary bridge assessment.

source_text: Tinulungan ng JOCCA ang regional partners na gawing praktikal na support options para sa apektadong estado ang situational awareness.
target_text: JOCCA helped regional partners translate situational awareness into practical support options for the affected state.

source_text: Binigyang-diin ng SCDF teams ang responder accountability sa mahahabang rescue operations sa hindi matatag at puno ng debris na mga gusali.
target_text: SCDF teams emphasized responder accountability during long rescue operations in unstable and debris-filled buildings.

source_text: Hiniling ng VINASARCOM sa mga probinsiya na ihiwalay ang agarang life-saving requests mula sa recovery needs bago magsumite ng assistance requirements.
target_text: VINASARCOM asked provinces to distinguish urgent life-saving requests from recovery needs before submitting assistance requirements.

source_text: Nakatulong ang flood projections ng VDDMA sa evacuation planners na magpasya kung aling mga komunidad ang dapat lumipat bago sumapit ang gabi.
target_text: VDDMA flood projections helped evacuation planners decide which communities should move before nightfall.

source_text: Ibinalik ng VPA engineering units ang akses sa isang rural clinic matapos harangin ng landslides ang tanging kalsada.
target_text: VPA engineering units restored access to a rural clinic after landslides blocked the only road.

source_text: Nagbabala ang MARD na dapat magsimula nang maaga ang agricultural damage assessments upang suportahan ang mga susunod na desisyon sa livelihood recovery.
target_text: MARD warned that agricultural damage assessments should begin early to support later livelihood recovery decisions.

source_text: Muling binuksan ng MOT ang secondary access road matapos kumpirmahin ng mga engineer na kaya nitong suportahan ang emergency vehicles.
target_text: MOT reopened a secondary access road after engineers confirmed it could support emergency vehicles.

source_text: Inikoordina ng MOH ang patient transfers nang mag-ulat ang district hospitals ng kakulangan sa trauma beds at oxygen supplies.
target_text: MOH coordinated patient transfers when district hospitals reported shortages of trauma beds and oxygen supplies.

source_text: Iminungkahi ng DRRP partners na iugnay ang exercise lessons sa preparedness improvements para sa schools, clinics, at commune authorities.
target_text: DRRP partners proposed linking exercise lessons to preparedness improvements for schools, clinics, and commune authorities.

source_text: Sinuportahan ng QPT grants ang community teams na nagpapanatili ng evacuation signs, local pumps, at basic rescue tools.
target_text: QPT grants supported community teams that maintained evacuation signs, local pumps, and basic rescue tools.

source_text: Tinulungan ng VNRC family tracing staff ang magkakahiwalay na kamag-anak na magpalitan ng impormasyon sa pamamagitan ng shelter registration desks.
target_text: VNRC family tracing staff helped separated relatives exchange information through shelter registration desks.

source_text: Inirekomenda ng VAMS ang mas malinaw na triggers para sa ambulance redistribution kapag sabay-sabay na humihiling ng transfers ang ilang ospital.
target_text: VAMS recommended clearer triggers for ambulance redistribution when several hospitals request transfers simultaneously.

source_text: Nirepaso ng WoG leaders ang health risks, transport restrictions, food security concerns, at engineering priorities sa iisang pulong.
target_text: WoG leaders reviewed health risks, transport restrictions, food security concerns, and engineering priorities in one meeting.

source_text: Hiniling ng NDMO sa partners na isama ang deployment timelines, sustainment needs, at limitations sa bawat assistance offer.
target_text: The NDMO asked partners to include deployment timelines, sustainment needs, and limitations in every assistance offer.

source_text: Inihambing ng CMCoord officers ang relief priorities sa military capabilities bago magrekomenda ng tasks para sa helicopters at engineering units.
target_text: CMCoord officers compared relief priorities with military capabilities before recommending tasks for helicopters and engineering units.

source_text: Nakatulong ang Mil-Mil coordination sa partner forces na i-deconflict ang radio frequencies at staging areas bago magsimula ang field movement.
target_text: Mil-Mil coordination helped partner forces deconflict radio frequencies and staging areas before field movement began.

source_text: Bumuti ang Civ-Mil briefings nang makatanggap ang humanitarian agencies ng predictable updates tungkol sa timing at ruta ng military convoy.
target_text: Civ-Mil briefings improved when humanitarian agencies received predictable updates on military convoy timing and routes.

source_text: Tinanggihan ng AS [Affected State] ang unsolicited supplies na gagamit ng warehouse space nang hindi tumutugon sa agarang humanitarian needs.
target_text: The AS [Affected State] declined unsolicited supplies that would have consumed warehouse space without meeting immediate humanitarian needs.

source_text: Ginamit ng MNCC ang validated RFAs upang magtalaga ng foreign military support habang iniiwasan ang pagdoble ng local capability.
target_text: The MNCC used validated RFAs to assign foreign military support while avoiding duplication of local capability.

source_text: Lumipat ang EOC staff sa backup communications matapos gambalain ng storm damage ang internet connectivity sa ilang distrito.
target_text: EOC staff shifted to backup communications after storm damage disrupted internet connectivity in several districts.

source_text: Tiniyak ng RFA process na bawat hiniling na asset ay tumutugon sa verified gap sa halip na pangkalahatang concern lamang.
target_text: The RFA process ensured that every requested asset addressed a verified gap rather than a general concern.

source_text: Ipinakita ng COP ang road status, hospital capacity, shelter occupancy, logistics constraints, at pending assistance offers.
target_text: The COP displayed road status, hospital capacity, shelter occupancy, logistics constraints, and pending assistance offers.

source_text: Pansamantalang itinigil ng SAR commanders ang river operations nang gawing masyadong mapanganib ng kondisyon ng panahon ang paghahanap sa gabi para sa responders.
target_text: SAR commanders paused river operations when weather conditions made night search too dangerous for responders.

source_text: Pare-parehong minarkahan ng USAR teams ang cleared areas upang maunawaan ng incoming crews ang natitirang hazards at search priorities.
target_text: USAR teams marked cleared areas consistently so incoming crews could understand remaining hazards and search priorities.

source_text: Isinama ng MSAR coordinators ang fishing communities dahil nakatulong ang local knowledge na pinuhin ang drift estimates at shoreline search areas.
target_text: MSAR coordinators included fishing communities because local knowledge helped refine drift estimates and shoreline search areas.

source_text: Nirepaso ng CBRE specialists ang container labels at drainage patterns bago muling buksan ang ruta malapit sa industrial zone.
target_text: CBRE specialists reviewed container labels and drainage patterns before reopening a route near the industrial zone.

source_text: Ipinakita ng IOI tracker na ang fuel availability, helicopter congestion, at shelter crowding ay nangangailangan ng senior-level decisions.
target_text: The IOI tracker showed that fuel availability, helicopter congestion, and shelter crowding required senior-level decisions.

source_text: Inuna ng WASH partners ang chlorination, latrine maintenance, at hygiene messaging matapos dumami ang mga ulat ng unsafe water.
target_text: WASH partners prioritized chlorination, latrine maintenance, and hygiene messaging after reports of unsafe water increased.

source_text: Isinaalang-alang ng NFI planning ang household size, disability needs, infant care, at mga pamilyang walang cooking equipment.
target_text: NFI planning accounted for household size, disability needs, infant care, and families without cooking equipment.

source_text: Kinolekta ng HOC ang community feedback na hindi nakikita sa MNCC logistics at movement boards.
target_text: The HOC collected community feedback that was not visible in the MNCC logistics and movement boards.

source_text: Isinunod-sunod ng LCC planners ang cargo upang mauna ang medical supplies, water treatment items, at fuel bago ang lower-priority materials.
target_text: LCC planners sequenced cargo so medical supplies, water treatment items, and fuel moved before lower-priority materials.

source_text: Hiniling ng AIC sa drone teams na magsumite ng flight plans dahil may helicopters na umaandar malapit sa parehong lambak.
target_text: The AIC required drone teams to submit flight plans because helicopters were operating near the same valley.

source_text: Nakatulong ang MASCAS procedures sa mga ospital na i-coordinate ang triage areas, transfer routes, at patient tracking sa panahon ng exercise.
target_text: MASCAS procedures helped hospitals coordinate triage areas, transfer routes, and patient tracking during the exercise.

source_text: Binawasan ng Mutual Recognition ang administrative delays para sa certified rescue teams habang pinananatili ang awtoridad ng host nation sa tasking.
target_text: Mutual Recognition reduced administrative delays for certified rescue teams while preserving host-nation authority over tasking.

source_text: Kinailangan ng APOD ng mas maraming forklift matapos dumating ang maraming relief flights na may palletized cargo na nangangailangan ng mechanical handling.
target_text: The APOD needed more forklifts after multiple relief flights arrived with palletized cargo requiring mechanical handling.

source_text: Naging mahalaga ang SPOD coordination nang dumating ang vessels na may heavy equipment habang disrupted pa rin ang commercial port operations.
target_text: SPOD coordination became important when vessels carrying heavy equipment arrived while commercial port operations were still disrupted.

source_text: Isinaalang-alang ng MSR assessment ang bridge strength, landslide exposure, fuel availability, at safe rest points.
target_text: The MSR assessment considered bridge strength, landslide exposure, fuel availability, and safe rest points.

source_text: Nakatulong ang CIQ coordination sa incoming teams na ma-clear ang communications gear, medical supplies, at rescue tools nang walang hindi kailangang pagkaantala.
target_text: CIQ coordination helped incoming teams clear communications gear, medical supplies, and rescue tools without unnecessary delay.

source_text: Araw-araw na nirepaso ng MCDA planners ang support tasks upang matiyak na nananatiling kailangan at proporsyonal ang military assistance.
target_text: MCDA planners reviewed support tasks daily to ensure military assistance remained necessary and proportionate.

source_text: Nakatulong ang HuMOCC concepts sa responders na talakayin ang liaison, information sharing, at task support nang hindi nalilito ang coordination sa command.
target_text: HuMOCC concepts helped responders discuss liaison, information sharing, and task support without confusing coordination with command.

source_text: Kasama sa mga pamamaraan ng DVI ang pamamahala ng impormasyon ng pamilya, proteksyon ng ebidensya, pagsasaalang-alang sa kultura, at koordinasyon sa lokal na pulisya.
target_text: DVI procedures included family information management, evidence protection, cultural considerations, and coordination with local police.

source_text: Iniulat ng LEMA officials na kailangan ng informal shelters ng lighting, water storage, at mas malinaw na registration support.
target_text: LEMA officials reported that informal shelters needed lighting, water storage, and clearer registration support.

source_text: Nagpasok ang Ex COORES controllers ng biglaang communications outage upang subukan ang backup reporting channels at leadership adaptability.
target_text: Ex COORES controllers introduced a sudden communications outage to test backup reporting channels and leadership adaptability.

source_text: Ipinakita ng TTX na kailangan ng decision briefs ng mas malinaw na options kapag maraming sektor ang humihiling ng kulang na transport assets.
target_text: The TTX revealed that decision briefs needed clearer options when multiple sectors requested scarce transport assets.

source_text: In-update ang OPERA CIS entries bago ang bawat pulong upang hindi kumilos ang mga lider batay sa outdated requests.
target_text: OPERA CIS entries were updated before each meeting so leaders would not act on outdated requests.

source_text: Ginabayan ng SASOP activation steps ang pagkakasunod-sunod mula sa national request hanggang ASEAN regional coordination.
target_text: SASOP activation steps guided the sequence from national request through ASEAN regional coordination.

source_text: Tumulong ang SASOP Chapter VI sa mga kalahok na talakayin ang customs, movement, at facilitation requirements para sa military assets.
target_text: SASOP Chapter VI helped participants discuss customs, movement, and facilitation requirements for military assets.

source_text: Sinuportahan ng AADMER commitments ang napapanahong information sharing at kooperasyon sa pagitan ng ASEAN disaster management authorities.
target_text: AADMER commitments supported timely information sharing and cooperation among ASEAN disaster management authorities.

source_text: Hinubog ng ARDEX lessons ang pressure points na may kaugnayan sa media attention, logistics delays, at competing sector priorities.
target_text: ARDEX lessons shaped the pressure points involving media attention, logistics delays, and competing sector priorities.

source_text: Inirekomenda ng SME sa health operations na direktang iugnay ang disease surveillance sa referral at isolation procedures.
target_text: The SME on health operations recommended linking disease surveillance directly to referral and isolation procedures.

source_text: Hiniling ng AAR facilitators sa bawat cell na tukuyin ang isang process improvement at isang practice na dapat panatilihin.
target_text: AAR facilitators asked each cell to identify one process improvement and one practice worth keeping.

source_text: Gumawa ang GenAI ng draft briefing notes mula sa mahahabang ulat, ngunit inalis ng staff ang unsupported o ambiguous statements.
target_text: GenAI produced draft briefing notes from long reports, but staff removed unsupported or ambiguous statements.

source_text: Tumulong ang LLM na ihambing ang multilingual updates upang maiwasan ng information team ang maling pagsasalin ng operational categories.
target_text: The LLM helped compare multilingual updates so the information team could avoid mistranslating operational categories.

source_text: Nagbigay ang Sentinel-1 products sa mga planner ng kumpiyansa na nanatiling binaha ang northern route kahit limitado ang ground access.
target_text: Sentinel-1 products gave planners confidence that the northern route remained flooded despite limited ground access.

source_text: Idinagdag ang Copernicus layers sa COP upang gabayan ang field verification teams patungo sa mga settlement na pinakamalubhang naapektuhan.
target_text: Copernicus layers were added to the COP to guide field verification teams toward the hardest-hit settlements.

source_text: Ipinakita ng Digital Twin na mas mababawasan ng temporary bridge ang travel time ng ambulansya kaysa sa karagdagang air support.
target_text: The Digital Twin showed that a temporary bridge could reduce ambulance travel time more than additional air support.

source_text: Kinailangan ng Hybrid Exercise planning na itugma ang timing ng remote policy injects sa field activities sa simulated APOD.
target_text: Hybrid Exercise planning required timing remote policy injects with field activities at the simulated APOD.

source_text: Lumitaw ang interoperability challenges nang gumamit ang partners ng magkakaibang coordinate formats at informal names para sa parehong mga baryo.
target_text: Interoperability challenges appeared when partners used different coordinate formats and informal names for the same villages.

source_text: Bumalik ang Information Overload sa panahon ng simulasyong aftershock hanggang ma-filter ang mga ulat sa mesa ng pamamahala ng impormasyon.
target_text: Information Overload returned during the aftershock inject until reports were filtered through the information management desk.

source_text: Kinailangan ng ToR na magsumite ang liaison officers ng maiikling updates, tukuyin ang blockers, at markahan ang decisions na kailangan mula sa leaders.
target_text: The ToR required liaison officers to submit concise updates, identify blockers, and flag decisions needed from leaders.

source_text: Nakasalalay ang CONOPS approval sa assumptions tungkol sa weather windows, port access, security conditions, at relief priorities.
target_text: CONOPS approval depended on assumptions about weather windows, port access, security conditions, and relief priorities.

source_text: Inabisuhan ng NFP ang partners nang tanggapin ang medical teams ngunit tanggihan ang karagdagang donated clothing.
target_text: The NFP notified partners when medical teams were accepted but additional donated clothing was declined.

source_text: Inayos ng HADR teams ang distribution plans matapos ipakita ng community feedback na technically open ang isang route ngunit hindi ligtas.
target_text: HADR teams adjusted distribution plans after community feedback showed that one route was technically open but unsafe.

source_text: Pinanatili ng Changi RHCC ang regional overview ng assets na offered, deployed, unavailable, o naghihintay ng tasking.
target_text: The Changi RHCC maintained a regional overview of assets that were offered, deployed, unavailable, or awaiting tasking.

source_text: Kinailangan ng sitwasyon sa river-island hamlets na linawin ng US INDOPACOM kung binago ng overloaded reception desk ang response sequence.
target_text: The situation in river-island hamlets required US INDOPACOM to clarify whether an overloaded reception desk changed the response sequence.

source_text: Binigyang-diin ng CFE-DM observers kung paano pinahusay ng disiplinadong meeting agendas ang decisions sa high-pressure exercise period.
target_text: CFE-DM observers highlighted how disciplined meeting agendas improved decisions during the high-pressure exercise period.

source_text: Tumulong ang AHA Centre na ipabatid ang ASEAN support options nang hindi lumilikha ng parallel request channels para sa affected government.
target_text: The AHA Centre helped communicate ASEAN support options without creating parallel request channels for the affected government.

source_text: Sinuportahan ng UN OCHA ang shared priorities brief na nag-ugnay ng humanitarian needs sa sector capacity at operational constraints.
target_text: UN OCHA supported a shared priorities brief that linked humanitarian needs to sector capacity and operational constraints.

source_text: Inirekomenda ng ASEAN-ERAT teams ang karagdagang assessment sa mga baryong hindi malinaw ang population movement matapos ang bagyo.
target_text: ASEAN-ERAT teams recommended further assessment in villages where population movement was unclear after the storm.

source_text: Tinulungan ng ACMC facilitators ang participants na talakayin ang tensyon sa pagitan ng mabilis na military support at humanitarian independence.
target_text: ACMC facilitators helped participants discuss the tension between rapid military support and humanitarian independence.

source_text: Ipinakita ng PDC modelling na maaaring muling bahain ang coastal roads kung sasabay ang high tide sa muling pag-ulan.
target_text: PDC modelling showed that coastal roads could flood again if high tide coincided with renewed rainfall.

source_text: Nirepaso ng WHO ang shelter layouts at inirekomenda ang mas mahusay na spacing, isolation capacity, sanitation access, at health referral procedures.
target_text: WHO reviewed shelter layouts and recommended better spacing, isolation capacity, sanitation access, and health referral procedures.

source_text: Naghanda ang WFP ng contingency routing para sa food deliveries sakaling isara ng muling pagbaha ang main warehouse access road.
target_text: WFP prepared contingency routing for food deliveries in case renewed flooding closed the main warehouse access road.

source_text: Sumang-ayon ang ISCG na pagsamahin ang sector updates sa isang maikling note sa halip na gumawa ng magkakahiwalay at magkakapatong na requests.
target_text: The ISCG agreed to combine sector updates into one concise note rather than producing separate overlapping requests.

source_text: Inuna ng USAID BHA ang partners na makapagpapakita ng local coordination, assessed needs, at realistic delivery capacity.
target_text: USAID BHA prioritized partners that could show local coordination, assessed needs, and realistic delivery capacity.

source_text: Napansin ng ADMM-Plus participants na kasinghalaga ng equipment ang liaison training para sa epektibong regional HADR support.
target_text: ADMM-Plus participants noted that liaison training is as important as equipment for effective regional HADR support.

source_text: Inirekomenda ng EWG on HADR ang mas malinaw na handover procedures para sa liaison officers na umiikot sa multinational coordination cells.
target_text: The EWG on HADR recommended clearer handover procedures for liaison officers rotating through multinational coordination cells.

source_text: Nakatulong ang INSARAG markings sa incoming crews na makilala ang searched rooms, identified hazards, at locations na kailangan pa ng technical work.
target_text: INSARAG markings helped incoming crews recognize searched rooms, identified hazards, and locations requiring further technical work.

source_text: Inarchive ng ASEAN Secretariat ang exercise outputs upang maikumpara ng future planners ang progress laban sa earlier recommendations.
target_text: The ASEAN Secretariat archived exercise outputs so future planners could compare progress against earlier recommendations.

source_text: Kasama sa mga ulat sa kahandaan ng AMRG on HADR ang mga timeline ng deployment, limitasyon sa sustainment, espesyalistang kakayahan, at coordination contacts.
target_text: AMRG on HADR readiness reports included deployment timelines, sustainment limits, specialist capabilities, and coordination contacts.

source_text: Nagpayo ang SAF personnel tungkol sa airfield reception, cargo movement, at coordination sa pagitan ng aviation staff at civilian authorities.
target_text: SAF personnel advised on airfield reception, cargo movement, and coordination between aviation staff and civilian authorities.

source_text: Nagbigay ang PLA engineering planners ng equipment limitations upang makapagtalaga ang MNCC ng realistic road repair tasks.
target_text: PLA engineering planners provided equipment limitations so the MNCC could assign realistic road repair tasks.

source_text: Tumulong ang JOCCA na maiwasan ang duplication sa pamamagitan ng paghahambing ng regional offers sa national priorities at pending assistance requests.
target_text: JOCCA helped prevent duplication by comparing regional offers with national priorities and pending assistance requests.

source_text: Nirepaso ng SCDF mentors ang casualty handover procedures kasama ang local teams bago magsimula ang collapsed-structure drill.
target_text: SCDF mentors reviewed casualty handover procedures with local teams before the collapsed-structure drill began.

source_text: Kinailangan ng VINASARCOM ng iisang updated needs list bago maglabas ng anumang bagong international assistance request.
target_text: VINASARCOM required a single updated needs list before any new international assistance request was issued.

source_text: Ipinakita ng VDDMA updates na nanatiling lampas sa danger level ang isang river section kahit bumababa ang rainfall totals.
target_text: VDDMA updates showed that one river section remained above danger level despite falling rainfall totals.

source_text: Naghatid ang VPA trucks ng relief cargo sa forward hub matapos kumpirmahin ng MOT na bukas ang secondary route.
target_text: VPA trucks transported relief cargo to a forward hub after MOT confirmed that the secondary route was open.

source_text: Iniulat ng MARD na magiging mahalaga ang livestock disease prevention kapag naging stable ang evacuation operations.
target_text: MARD reported that livestock disease prevention would become important once evacuation operations stabilized.

source_text: Binalaan ng MOT ang convoy planners na kaya ng repaired bridge ang ambulances ngunit hindi ang fully loaded cargo trucks.
target_text: MOT warned convoy planners that a repaired bridge could support ambulances but not fully loaded cargo trucks.

source_text: Humiling ang MOH ng karagdagang coordination sa WHO tungkol sa shelter disease surveillance at patient referral procedures.
target_text: MOH requested additional coordination with WHO on shelter disease surveillance and patient referral procedures.

source_text: Tinukoy ng DRRP members ang preparedness lessons tungkol sa early warning, evacuation drills, at local stockpiles.
target_text: DRRP members identified preparedness lessons related to early warning, evacuation drills, and local stockpiles.

source_text: Pinahintulutan ng QPT-supported equipment ang village teams na simulan ang paglilinis ng maliliit na drains bago dumating ang national responders.
target_text: QPT-supported equipment allowed village teams to begin clearing small drains before national responders arrived.

source_text: Nagbahagi ang VNRC volunteers ng beneficiary feedback na nagpasya sa planners na ayusin ang delivery times sa dalawang evacuation centres.
target_text: VNRC volunteers shared beneficiary feedback that led planners to adjust delivery times at two evacuation centres.

source_text: In-update ng VAMS ang health cell tungkol sa hospital oxygen levels, ambulance queues, at transfer capacity bago ang evening briefing.
target_text: VAMS updated the health cell on hospital oxygen levels, ambulance queues, and transfer capacity before the evening briefing.

source_text: Napigilan ng WoG coordination ang conflicting public messages tungkol sa evacuation timing, road restrictions, at shelter health precautions.
target_text: WoG coordination prevented conflicting public messages on evacuation timing, road restrictions, and shelter health precautions.

source_text: Tinapos ng NDMO ang official needs list matapos pagtugmain ang provincial reports sa field assessment findings.
target_text: The NDMO finalized the official needs list after reconciling provincial reports with field assessment findings.

source_text: Tumulong ang CMCoord staff na matiyak na naitalaga ang military engineering support sa access restoration sa halip na general construction work.
target_text: CMCoord staff helped ensure military engineering support was assigned to access restoration rather than general construction work.

source_text: Isinara ng NFP ang ilang pending offers matapos kumpirmahing natugunan na ng local resources ang identified requirements.
target_text: The NFP closed several pending offers after confirming that local resources had already met the identified requirements.

source_text: Pinangkat ng mga HADR coordinator ang mga agarang pangangailangan sa mga kategorya ng rescue, health, logistics, shelter, at WASH bago magtalaga ng mga susunod na aksyon.
target_text: HADR coordinators grouped urgent needs into rescue, health, logistics, shelter, and WASH categories before assigning follow-up actions.

source_text: Binigyan ng briefing ng Changi RHCC ang mga opisyal na tagapag-ugnay ng partner tungkol sa tinanggap na tulong, natitirang puwang, at mga kakayahang naghihintay pa ng pag-apruba ng bansang tumatanggap.
target_text: The Changi RHCC briefed partner liaison officers on accepted assistance, remaining gaps, and capabilities still awaiting host-nation approval.

source_text: Nag-alok ang US INDOPACOM ng planning support para sa air movement matapos kumpirmahin ng civilian authorities na nananatiling hindi madaanan sa kalsada ang ilang distrito.
target_text: US INDOPACOM offered planning support for air movement after civilian authorities confirmed that several districts remained inaccessible by road.

source_text: Nakatulong ang CFE-DM reference notes sa evaluation team na tukuyin kung ang coordination problems ay mula sa unclear roles o poor information flow.
target_text: CFE-DM reference notes helped the evaluation team identify whether coordination problems came from unclear roles or poor information flow.

source_text: In-update ng AHA Centre ang regional partners matapos kumpirmahin ng affected state ang karagdagang pangangailangan para sa water purification at temporary shelter.
target_text: The AHA Centre updated regional partners after the affected state confirmed additional needs for water purification and temporary shelter.

source_text: Nakipagtulungan ang UN OCHA sa cluster representatives upang gawing maikling set ng humanitarian priorities ang mahahabang field inputs.
target_text: UN OCHA worked with cluster representatives to turn lengthy field inputs into a concise set of humanitarian priorities.

source_text: Bineripika ng ASEAN-ERAT ang reports mula sa community leaders bago irekomenda kung mobile clinics muna ang dapat bumisita sa isolated villages.
target_text: ASEAN-ERAT verified reports from community leaders before recommending whether mobile clinics should visit the isolated villages first.

source_text: Nakatulong ang ACMC guidance sa military officers na maunawaan kung bakit dapat balansehin ang speed, visibility, at control sa humanitarian principles.
target_text: ACMC guidance helped military officers understand why speed, visibility, and control must be balanced with humanitarian principles.

source_text: Inihambing ng PDC analysts ang storm-track forecasts sa exposed population data upang markahan ang coastal districts na kailangan ng early warning reinforcement.
target_text: PDC analysts compared storm-track forecasts with exposed population data to flag coastal districts needing early warning reinforcement.

source_text: Pinayuhan ng WHO ang shelter health desk na i-monitor ang chronic disease patients na nawalan ng access sa regular medication.
target_text: WHO advised the shelter health desk to monitor chronic disease patients who had lost access to regular medication.

source_text: Nag-ayos ang WFP ng split delivery plan upang maabot ng food stocks ang malalaking shelters at mas maliliit na informal sites.
target_text: WFP arranged a split delivery plan so food stocks could reach both large shelters and smaller informal sites.

source_text: Hiniling ng ISCG sa bawat sector na iulat ang top constraints, available capacity, at decisions required bago ang susunod na coordination call.
target_text: The ISCG asked each sector to report top constraints, available capacity, and decisions required before the next coordination call.

source_text: Tinalakay ng USAID BHA ang partner coverage maps upang matiyak na hindi nag-iiwan ng overlooked pockets of need ang donor-funded activities.
target_text: USAID BHA discussed partner coverage maps to ensure donor-funded activities did not leave overlooked pockets of need.

source_text: Nirepaso ng ADMM-Plus members kung paano makakasuporta ang regional military cooperation sa disaster response habang pinananatili ang affected-state leadership.
target_text: ADMM-Plus members reviewed how regional military cooperation could support disaster response while preserving affected-state leadership.

source_text: Sinuri ng EWG on HADR kung mapapahusay ng common templates ang paraan ng pag-uulat ng partner forces ng available assets.
target_text: The EWG on HADR examined whether common templates could improve the way partner forces reported available assets.

source_text: Nagbigay ang INSARAG coordination procedures sa arriving rescue teams ng shared method para sa site triage at worksite assignment.
target_text: INSARAG coordination procedures gave arriving rescue teams a shared method for site triage and worksite assignment.

source_text: Pinagsama-sama ng ASEAN Secretariat ang follow-up tasks mula sa regional meeting upang matrack ang mga ito pagkatapos ng exercise.
target_text: The ASEAN Secretariat compiled follow-up tasks from the regional meeting so they could be tracked after the exercise.

source_text: Inihambing ng AMRG on HADR representatives ang force packages para sa medical evacuation, transport, engineering, at water purification support.
target_text: AMRG on HADR representatives compared force packages for medical evacuation, transport, engineering, and water purification support.

source_text: Nirepaso ng SAF planners ang runway conditions, cargo handling capacity, at airfield congestion bago irekomenda ang flight sequencing.
target_text: SAF planners reviewed runway conditions, cargo handling capacity, and airfield congestion before recommending flight sequencing.

source_text: Inilarawan ng PLA liaison ang engineering capabilities sa terms ng bridge assessment, debris clearance, at temporary access restoration.
target_text: The PLA liaison described engineering capabilities in terms of bridge assessment, debris clearance, and temporary access restoration.

source_text: Isinalin ng JOCCA ang regional assistance updates sa iisang coordination brief para sa decision-makers ng affected state.
target_text: JOCCA translated regional assistance updates into a single coordination brief for the affected state's decision-makers.

source_text: Binigyang-diin ng SCDF mentors ang pangangailangan ng disciplined safety checks bago pumasok ang teams sa partially collapsed buildings sa panahon ng aftershocks.
target_text: SCDF mentors emphasized the need for disciplined safety checks before teams entered partially collapsed buildings during aftershocks.

source_text: Humiling ang VINASARCOM ng updated provincial reports bago aprubahan ang second wave ng international assistance offers.
target_text: VINASARCOM requested updated provincial reports before approving a second wave of international assistance offers.

source_text: Nagbabala ang VDDMA engineers na maaaring bumigay ang saturated embankments kahit nagsisimula nang bumaba ang rainfall totals.
target_text: VDDMA engineers warned that saturated embankments could fail even if rainfall totals began to decline.

source_text: Sinuportahan ng VPA units ang route clearance habang tinukoy ng local officials kung aling communities ang unang nangangailangan na mabuksan muli ang kalsada.
target_text: VPA units supported route clearance while local officials identified which communities needed the road reopened first.

source_text: Iniulat ng MARD na maaaring maantala ng damaged irrigation pumps ang agricultural recovery matagal matapos magsara ang emergency shelters.
target_text: MARD reported that damaged irrigation pumps could delay agricultural recovery long after emergency shelters closed.

source_text: Nakipag-ugnayan ang MOT traffic managers sa police upang kontrolin ang convoy movement sa makikitid at bahagyang nasirang roads.
target_text: MOT traffic managers coordinated with police to control convoy movement through narrow and partially damaged roads.

source_text: Hiniling ng MOH sa hospitals na iulat ang oxygen stocks, trauma capacity, at ambulance delays tuwing apat na oras.
target_text: MOH asked hospitals to report oxygen stocks, trauma capacity, and ambulance delays every four hours.

source_text: Iminungkahi ng DRRP members na gamitin ang response lessons upang palakasin ang local preparedness plans bago ang susunod na typhoon season.
target_text: DRRP members proposed using response lessons to strengthen local preparedness plans before the next typhoon season.

source_text: Nakatulong ang QPT investments sa village warning systems upang makalikas ang residents bago umabot ang floodwater sa main access road.
target_text: QPT investments in village warning systems helped residents evacuate before floodwater reached the main access road.

source_text: Kinolekta ng VNRC teams ang community feedback tungkol sa distribution timing, shelter conditions, at missing family members.
target_text: VNRC teams collected community feedback on distribution timing, shelter conditions, and missing family members.

source_text: Tinukoy ng VAMS ang referral bottlenecks matapos mag-ulat ang dalawang district hospitals ng ambulance queues at limited surgical capacity.
target_text: VAMS identified referral bottlenecks after two district hospitals reported ambulance queues and limited surgical capacity.

source_text: Tumulong ang WoG planning sa ministries na lutasin ang competing priorities sa road clearance, hospital support, food delivery, at shelter management.
