target_text: WoG planning helped ministries resolve competing priorities between road clearance, hospital support, food delivery, and shelter management.

source_text: Sinala ng NDMO ang international offers sa pamamagitan ng official needs list bago ibahagi ang tasking recommendations sa partners.
target_text: The NDMO filtered international offers through the official needs list before sharing tasking recommendations with partners.

source_text: Ipinaliwanag ng CMCoord staff kung paano makakatulong ang military trucks sa humanitarian deliveries nang hindi binabago ang civilian distribution plan.
target_text: CMCoord staff explained how military trucks could support humanitarian deliveries without changing the civilian distribution plan.

source_text: Nakatulong ang Mil-Mil communication sa partner contingents na i-coordinate ang staging areas nang hindi nagdaragdag ng pressure sa civilian operations centre.
target_text: Mil-Mil communication helped partner contingents coordinate staging areas without adding pressure to the civilian operations centre.

source_text: Nagbigay ang Civ-Mil liaison meetings sa local NGOs ng channel upang magtaas ng access problems bago ilabas ang military movement orders.
target_text: Civ-Mil liaison meetings gave local NGOs a channel to raise access problems before military movement orders were issued.

source_text: Bilang AS [Affected State], kinumpirma ng pamahalaan na lahat ng incoming teams ay kikilos sa ilalim ng national disaster management priorities.
target_text: As the AS [Affected State], the government confirmed that all incoming teams would operate under national disaster management priorities.

source_text: Sinubaybayan ng MNCC ang foreign military support requests mula approval hanggang completion upang walang aircraft o engineering team na ma-double-task.
target_text: The MNCC tracked foreign military support requests from approval through completion so no aircraft or engineering team was double-tasked.

source_text: Ginamit ng EOC managers ang district updates upang magpasya kung kailangan ng immediate escalation ang evacuation support o hospital resupply.
target_text: EOC managers used district updates to decide whether evacuation support or hospital resupply needed immediate escalation.

source_text: Inilarawan ng RFA para sa airlift ang cargo type, passenger numbers, loading point, destination, at time sensitivity.
target_text: The RFA for airlift described cargo type, passenger numbers, loading point, destination, and time sensitivity.

source_text: Kasama sa COP ang confidence levels para sa flood maps, road reports, shelter figures, at hospital capacity estimates.
target_text: The COP included confidence levels for flood maps, road reports, shelter figures, and hospital capacity estimates.

source_text: Nakipag-ugnayan ang SAR teams sa village leaders upang tukuyin ang homes kung saan maaaring hindi sinunod ng residents ang evacuation orders.
target_text: SAR teams coordinated with village leaders to identify homes where residents might have ignored evacuation orders.

source_text: Humiling ang USAR crews ng updated structural information bago pumasok sa damaged office block malapit sa riverfront.
target_text: USAR crews requested updated structural information before entering the damaged office block near the riverfront.

source_text: Inayos ng MSAR planners ang search area matapos magbago magdamag ang wind at tide data sa drift estimates.
target_text: MSAR planners adjusted the search area after wind and tide data changed overnight drift estimates.

source_text: Nagtatag ang CBRE responders ng safety perimeter sa paligid ng warehouse hanggang maging available ang air monitoring results.
target_text: CBRE responders established a safety perimeter around the warehouse until air monitoring results were available.

source_text: Inilista ng IOI board ang unresolved decisions tungkol sa relief flight sequencing, customs delays, shelter crowding, at public messaging.
target_text: The IOI board listed unresolved decisions on relief flight sequencing, customs delays, shelter crowding, and public messaging.

source_text: Inuna ng WASH partners ang safe water storage dahil ginagamit muli ng ilang pamilya ang contaminated containers sa evacuation centres.
target_text: WASH partners prioritized safe water storage because some families were reusing contaminated containers in evacuation centres.

source_text: Iniugnay ng logistics clerks ang NFI sa mas mahusay na handover note matapos magbago magdamag ang mga ulat mula sa river-island hamlets.
target_text: logistics clerks linked NFI to a better handover note after reports from river-island hamlets changed overnight.

source_text: Kinolekta ng HOC ang protection concerns mula sa humanitarian partners bago mag-brief sa military coordination element.
target_text: The HOC gathered protection concerns from humanitarian partners before briefing the military coordination element.

source_text: Inihambing ng LCC officers ang convoy capacity sa urgent cargo requests bago ilabas ang trucks sa forward hub.
target_text: LCC officers compared convoy capacity with urgent cargo requests before releasing trucks to the forward hub.

source_text: Inantala ng AIC ang survey drone mission hanggang makaalis ang medical evacuation helicopters sa kalapit na air corridor.
target_text: The AIC delayed a survey drone mission until medical evacuation helicopters cleared the nearby air corridor.

source_text: Sinubok ng MASCAS injects kung kaya ng ambulance dispatchers na i-route ang patients kapag sabay na umabot sa capacity ang dalawang hospitals.
target_text: MASCAS injects tested whether ambulance dispatchers could route patients when two hospitals reached capacity simultaneously.

source_text: Nakatulong ang Mutual Recognition sa host nation na i-integrate ang certified rescue teams nang hindi inuulit ang full qualification reviews.
target_text: Mutual Recognition helped the host nation integrate certified rescue teams without repeating full qualification reviews.

source_text: Gumawa ang APOD team ng magkakahiwalay na lanes para sa personnel reception, cargo handling, at onward transport assignment.
target_text: The APOD team created separate lanes for personnel reception, cargo handling, and onward transport assignment.

source_text: Iskinedyul ng SPOD managers ang heavy equipment offload sa gabi upang mabawasan ang interference sa daytime relief cargo movement.
target_text: SPOD managers scheduled heavy equipment offload at night to reduce interference with daytime relief cargo movement.

source_text: Muling nabuksan ang MSR matapos mag-install ang engineers ng temporary drainage at maglinis ng putik sa pinakamatarik na bahagi.
target_text: The MSR reopened after engineers installed temporary drainage and cleared mud from the steepest section.

source_text: Bumuti ang CIQ processing nang magsumite ang incoming teams ng equipment lists, medical supplies, at passport details bago umalis.
target_text: CIQ processing improved when incoming teams submitted equipment lists, medical supplies, and passport details before departure.

source_text: Nilimitahan ang MCDA requests sa time-sensitive gaps na hindi kayang tugunan ng civilian responders gamit ang available resources.
target_text: MCDA requests were limited to time-sensitive gaps that civilian responders could not address with available resources.

source_text: Nagbigay ang HuMOCC principles sa coordination cell ng neutral na wika para talakayin ang military support sa humanitarian tasks.
target_text: HuMOCC principles gave the coordination cell a neutral language for discussing military support to humanitarian tasks.

source_text: Nakipagtulungan ang DVI personnel sa local authorities upang i-record ang missing-person information at pamahalaan nang may respeto ang identification procedures.
target_text: DVI personnel worked with local authorities to record missing-person information and manage identification procedures respectfully.

source_text: Ipinaalam ng LEMA sa national planners na walang water supply ang isang nakalistang evacuation centre at hindi dapat tumanggap ng mas maraming pamilya.
target_text: LEMA informed national planners that one listed evacuation centre had no water supply and should not receive more families.

source_text: Inobserbahan ng Ex COORES evaluators kung gaano kabilis nakilala ng participants ang duplicated offers at nai-redirect ang support sa unmet needs.
target_text: Ex COORES evaluators observed how quickly participants recognized duplicated offers and redirected support to unmet needs.

source_text: Hinamon ng TTX ang officials na mag-prioritize sa pagitan ng airlift para sa medical supplies at engineering support para sa damaged bridge.
target_text: The TTX challenged officials to prioritize between airlift for medical supplies and engineering support for a damaged bridge.

source_text: Nakatulong ang OPERA CIS entries sa information team na makita kung aling requests ang kailangan ng clarification bago ma-task.
target_text: OPERA CIS entries helped the information team see which requests needed clarification before they could be tasked.

source_text: Sinuportahan ng SASOP guidance ang talakayan kung paano dapat hilingin, padaliin, at iulat ang ASEAN standby arrangements.
target_text: SASOP guidance supported the discussion on how ASEAN standby arrangements should be requested, facilitated, and reported.

source_text: Tumulong ang SASOP Chapter VI sa legal advisers na ipaliwanag ang requirements para sa pagtanggap at coordination ng foreign military assets.
target_text: SASOP Chapter VI helped legal advisers explain requirements for receiving and coordinating foreign military assets.

source_text: Ginamit ang AADMER bilang policy reference para sa regional cooperation, mutual assistance, at information sharing.
target_text: AADMER was used as the policy reference for regional cooperation, mutual assistance, and information sharing.

source_text: Naimpluwensiyahan ng ARDEX lessons ang desisyon na isama ang sabay-sabay na port disruption, flooding, at public health injects.
target_text: ARDEX lessons influenced the decision to include simultaneous port disruption, flooding, and public health injects.

source_text: Inirekomenda ng SME na isama sa future scenarios ang mas malaking pressure sa information managers sa peak reporting periods.
target_text: The SME recommended that future scenarios include more pressure on information managers during peak reporting periods.

source_text: Tinukoy ng AAR ang gaps sa liaison shift handovers, task closure procedures, at kalidad ng sector summaries.
target_text: The AAR identified gaps in liaison shift handovers, task closure procedures, and the quality of sector summaries.

source_text: Gumawa ang GenAI ng unang draft ng situation summary, ngunit sinuri ng analysts ang bawat linya laban sa verified reports.
target_text: GenAI produced a first draft of the situation summary, but analysts checked every line against verified reports.

source_text: Tumulong ang LLM na gawing plain-language updates para sa coordination briefing ang technical assessment notes.
target_text: The LLM helped convert technical assessment notes into plain-language updates for the coordination briefing.

source_text: Sinuportahan ng Sentinel-1 radar imagery ang flood mapping nang hindi marating ng ground patrols ang northern river basin.
target_text: Sentinel-1 radar imagery supported flood mapping when ground patrols could not reach the northern river basin.

source_text: Nakatulong ang Copernicus products na ihambing ang affected settlements, damaged roads, at likely access constraints sa buong probinsiya.
target_text: Copernicus products helped compare affected settlements, damaged roads, and likely access constraints across the province.

source_text: Pinahintulutan ng Digital Twin ang planners na subukan kung mapapaikli ng paglipat ng staging area ang delivery times.
target_text: The Digital Twin allowed planners to test whether moving the staging area would shorten delivery times.

source_text: Pinagsama ng Hybrid Exercise ang policy-level problem solving at field-level reception tasks sa simulated airport.
target_text: The Hybrid Exercise combined policy-level problem solving with field-level reception tasks at the simulated airport.

source_text: Bumaba ang interoperability problems nang gumamit ang lahat ng teams ng parehong spreadsheet headings at district identifiers.
target_text: Interoperability problems decreased once all teams used the same spreadsheet headings and district identifiers.

source_text: Tumaas ang Information Overload nang makarating sa senior briefing team ang unfiltered photographs, raw notes, at duplicate reports.
target_text: Information Overload increased when unfiltered photographs, raw notes, and duplicate reports reached the senior briefing team.

source_text: Kinailangan ng ToR na magbigay ang bawat cell lead ng concise updates at tukuyin ang decisions na kailangan ng leadership attention.
target_text: The ToR required each cell lead to provide concise updates and identify decisions that needed leadership attention.

source_text: Nirebisa ang CONOPS assumptions matapos paikliin ng bagong weather forecasts ang available window para sa helicopter operations.
target_text: CONOPS assumptions were revised after new weather forecasts shortened the available window for helicopter operations.

source_text: Tinanggap lamang ng NFP ang bagong offers matapos kumpirmahin kung tumutugma ang mga ito sa pinakahuling validated needs list.
target_text: The NFP acknowledged new offers only after confirming whether they matched the latest validated needs list.

source_text: Lumipat ang HADR teams mula rapid response patungo sa stabilization nang matapos ang rescue operations at maging pangunahing priority ang shelter services.
target_text: HADR teams shifted from rapid response to stabilization once rescue operations ended and shelter services became the main priority.

source_text: Tumulong ang Changi RHCC na panatilihin ang regional situational awareness sa pamamagitan ng paghahambing ng partner capabilities sa accepted RFAs.
target_text: The Changi RHCC helped maintain regional situational awareness by comparing partner capabilities with accepted RFAs.

source_text: Ibinahagi ng US INDOPACOM planners ang aircraft constraints upang maiwasan ng MNCC ang pagtatalaga ng unsuitable cargo missions.
target_text: US INDOPACOM planners shared aircraft constraints so the MNCC could avoid assigning unsuitable cargo missions.

source_text: Sinuportahan ng CFE-DM materials ang talakayan kung bakit mahalaga ang information discipline sa mabilis na multinational operations.
target_text: CFE-DM materials supported a discussion on why information discipline matters during fast-moving multinational operations.

source_text: Nakipag-ugnayan ang AHA Centre sa NDMO upang i-update ang ASEAN partners tungkol sa logistics gaps at shelter priorities.
target_text: The AHA Centre coordinated with the NDMO to update ASEAN partners on logistics gaps and shelter priorities.

source_text: Tumulong ang UN OCHA sa partners na maghanda ng joint message tungkol sa humanitarian access at impartial assistance.
target_text: UN OCHA helped partners prepare a joint message on humanitarian access and impartial assistance.

source_text: Ipinakita ng ASEAN-ERAT findings na mas agarang kailangan ng ilang baryo ang medical outreach kaysa karagdagang food supplies.
target_text: ASEAN-ERAT findings showed that some villages needed medical outreach more urgently than additional food supplies.

source_text: Hinimok ng ACMC advisers ang planners na idokumento ang assumptions tuwing ginagamit ang military assets para sa civilian relief tasks.
target_text: ACMC advisers encouraged planners to document assumptions whenever military assets were used for civilian relief tasks.

source_text: Binigyang-diin ng PDC modelling na ang isang distrito ay parehong may flood exposure at limitadong evacuation-route redundancy.
target_text: PDC modelling highlighted that one district faced both flood exposure and limited evacuation-route redundancy.

source_text: Inirekomenda ng WHO na i-map ng health teams ang referral options para sa dialysis, maternity care, at trauma treatment.
target_text: WHO recommended that health teams map referral options for dialysis, maternity care, and trauma treatment.

source_text: Nakipag-ugnayan ang WFP sa local transport providers matapos maging malaking operational constraint ang commercial trucking capacity.
target_text: WFP coordinated with local transport providers after commercial trucking capacity became a major operational constraint.

source_text: Pinagsama ng ISCG ang sector needs upang maikumpara ng donors ang urgent gaps nang hindi nagbabasa ng magkakahiwalay na technical reports.
target_text: The ISCG consolidated sector needs so donors could compare urgent gaps without reading separate technical reports.

source_text: Nirepaso ng USAID BHA kung kasama sa proposed activities ang coordination sa local authorities at realistic delivery timelines.
target_text: USAID BHA reviewed whether proposed activities included coordination with local authorities and realistic delivery timelines.

source_text: Napansin ng ADMM-Plus observers na pinahusay ng common procedures ang trust bago tumaas ang operational pressure sa scenario.
target_text: ADMM-Plus observers noted that common procedures improved trust before operational pressure increased during the scenario.

source_text: Inirekomenda ng EWG on HADR ang mas madalas na rehearsal ng multinational logistics coordination sa regional exercises.
target_text: The EWG on HADR recommended more frequent rehearsal of multinational logistics coordination during regional exercises.

source_text: Binawasan ng INSARAG worksite management ang kalituhan nang dumating ang maraming rescue teams sa parehong collapsed structure.
target_text: INSARAG worksite management reduced confusion when multiple rescue teams arrived at the same collapsed structure.

source_text: Iningatan ng ASEAN Secretariat ang official record of decisions para sa follow-up sa future regional HADR meetings.
target_text: The ASEAN Secretariat preserved the official record of decisions for follow-up during future regional HADR meetings.

source_text: Sinuri ng AMRG on HADR participants kung may sapat na self-sustainment ang deployable units para sa remote operations.
target_text: AMRG on HADR participants examined whether deployable units had enough self-sustainment for remote operations.

source_text: Nagbahagi ang SAF teams ng karanasan sa pagsasama ng medical evacuation planning sa airfield reception procedures.
target_text: SAF teams shared experience on integrating medical evacuation planning with airfield reception procedures.

source_text: Humiling ang PLA engineers ng local survey data bago magtalaga ng equipment sa damaged river crossing.
target_text: PLA engineers requested local survey data before committing equipment to the damaged river crossing.

source_text: Tumulong ang JOCCA na tukuyin kung kailan dapat i-redirect ang regional offer dahil natugunan na ang original need.
target_text: JOCCA helped identify when a regional offer should be redirected because the original need had already been met.

source_text: Nirepaso ng SCDF instructors ang technical rescue communication protocols kasama ang local teams bago ang night exercise.
target_text: SCDF instructors reviewed technical rescue communication protocols with local teams before the night exercise.

source_text: Inikoordina ng VINASARCOM ang national approvals upang hindi hiwalay na makipagnegosasyon ang international partners sa maraming probinsiya.
target_text: VINASARCOM coordinated national approvals so international partners would not negotiate separately with multiple provinces.

source_text: Nakatulong ang VDDMA updates sa evacuation planners na asahan kung aling low-lying areas ang muling maaaring bahain pagkatapos ng dam releases.
target_text: VDDMA updates helped evacuation planners anticipate which low-lying areas could flood again after dam releases.

source_text: Pinahintulutan ng VPA logistics support na makalampas ang relief items sa puntong hindi na ligtas para sa civilian trucks.
target_text: VPA logistics support allowed relief items to move beyond the point where civilian trucks could safely operate.

source_text: Sinuportahan ng MARD damage reports ang planning para sa animal health, seed replacement, at restoration of irrigation systems.
target_text: MARD damage reports supported planning for animal health, seed replacement, and restoration of irrigation systems.

source_text: Ipinaalam ng MOT sa LCC na dalawang secondary roads ay bukas lamang sa light vehicles.
target_text: MOT informed the LCC that two secondary roads were open only to light vehicles.

source_text: Hiniling ng MOH sa health coordination cell na maghanda para sa pagtaas ng shelter-related illness sa susunod na linggo.
target_text: MOH asked the health coordination cell to prepare for increased shelter-related illness over the next week.

source_text: Iminungkahi ng DRRP partners ang community training batay sa gaps na nakita sa early warning at evacuation behavior.
target_text: DRRP partners proposed community training based on gaps observed in early warning and evacuation behavior.

source_text: Nakatulong ang QPT-supported preparedness activities sa local volunteers na pamahalaan ang initial evacuation bago dumating ang national resources.
target_text: QPT-supported preparedness activities helped local volunteers manage initial evacuation before national resources arrived.

source_text: Tinulungan ng VNRC branch staff ang shelter managers na tukuyin ang separated children, older evacuees, at families requiring special assistance.
target_text: VNRC branch staff helped shelter managers identify separated children, older evacuees, and families requiring special assistance.

source_text: Inirekomenda ng VAMS na idagdag ang ambulance status indicators sa shared health dashboard na ginagamit ng EOC.
target_text: VAMS recommended adding ambulance status indicators to the shared health dashboard used by the EOC.

source_text: Binawasan ng WoG coordination ang kalituhan nang kailangang maglabas ang ministries ng joint instructions tungkol sa evacuation, road closures, at health precautions.
target_text: WoG coordination reduced confusion when ministries had to issue joint instructions on evacuation, road closures, and health precautions.

source_text: Hiniling ng NDMO sa partners na linawin kung kasama sa kanilang offers ang transport, fuel, interpreters, at self-sustainment.
target_text: The NDMO asked partners to clarify whether their offers included transport, fuel, interpreters, and self-sustainment.

source_text: Nakatulong ang CMCoord discussions na gawing specific tasks para sa trucks, helicopters, at engineers ang broad request for support.
target_text: CMCoord discussions helped convert a broad request for support into specific tasks for trucks, helicopters, and engineers.

source_text: Na-deconflict ng Mil-Mil channels ang helicopter parking at refuelling bago makaapekto ang congestion sa humanitarian air movements.
target_text: Mil-Mil channels deconflicted helicopter parking and refuelling before congestion affected humanitarian air movements.

source_text: Tiniyak ng Civ-Mil coordination na hindi haharang ang convoy movements sa access sa civilian distribution points.
target_text: Civ-Mil coordination ensured that convoy movements did not block access to civilian distribution points.

source_text: Hiniling ng AS [Affected State] na ibahagi ng lahat ng international teams ang daily plans bago gumalaw sa labas ng assigned areas.
target_text: The AS [Affected State] requested that all international teams share daily plans before moving outside assigned areas.

source_text: Nakipag-ugnayan ang MNCC sa HOC upang matiyak na aligned ang military logistics support sa civilian humanitarian priorities.
target_text: The MNCC coordinated with the HOC to ensure military logistics support aligned with civilian humanitarian priorities.

source_text: In-update ng EOC staff ang incident map matapos kumpirmahin ng field teams na tatlong tulay ay magagamit lamang ng small vehicles.
target_text: EOC staff updated the incident map after field teams confirmed three bridges were usable only for small vehicles.

source_text: Inuna ang RFA para sa water treatment support matapos ipakita ng WASH reports ang tumataas na health risks sa shelters.
target_text: An RFA for water treatment support was prioritized after WASH reports showed rising health risks in shelters.

source_text: Tinulungan ng COP ang leaders na ihambing ang verified needs sa available assets bago pumili ng susunod na operational priorities.
target_text: The COP helped leaders compare verified needs against available assets before choosing the next operational priorities.

source_text: Lumipat ang SAR operations sa secondary search matapos kumpirmahin ng local authorities na tapos na ang immediate life-threatening rescues.
target_text: SAR operations moved to secondary search after local authorities confirmed that immediate life-threatening rescues were complete.

source_text: Nakipag-ugnayan ang USAR teams sa DVI specialists nang lumipat ang search operations mula rescue patungo sa recovery sa isang building.
target_text: USAR teams coordinated with DVI specialists when search operations shifted from rescue to recovery in one building.

source_text: Inayos ng MSAR units ang boat patterns matapos gawing hindi ligtas ng weather conditions ang original search grid.
target_text: MSAR units adjusted boat patterns after weather conditions made the original search grid unsafe.

source_text: Na-rule out ang CBRE hazards bago aprubahan ang warehouse site para sa temporary relief storage.
target_text: CBRE hazards were ruled out before the warehouse site was approved for temporary relief storage.

source_text: Tinulungan ng IOI tracker ang decision-makers na makita kung aling issues ang nangangailangan ng policy guidance sa halip na routine operational action.
target_text: The IOI tracker helped decision-makers see which issues required policy guidance rather than routine operational action.

source_text: Nakipag-ugnayan ang WASH teams sa MOH dahil maaaring mabilis na maging public health problem ang poor sanitation sa shelters.
target_text: WASH teams coordinated with MOH because poor sanitation in shelters could quickly become a public health problem.

source_text: In-update ang NFI stock levels bago mag-commit ang planners ng karagdagang blankets, hygiene kits, at kitchen sets.
target_text: NFI stock levels were updated before planners committed additional blankets, hygiene kits, and kitchen sets.

source_text: Iniakyat ng HOC ang community concerns tungkol sa distribution equity na hindi nakikita sa logistics reports.
target_text: The HOC escalated community concerns about distribution equity that were not visible in logistics reports.

source_text: Nag-assign ang LCC planners ng scarce trucks batay sa cargo urgency, destination access, at unloading capacity.
target_text: LCC planners assigned scarce trucks based on cargo urgency, destination access, and unloading capacity.

source_text: Napigilan ng AIC coordination ang drone mapping sortie na mag-conflict sa helicopter medical evacuation sa parehong ruta.
target_text: AIC coordination prevented a drone mapping sortie from conflicting with helicopter medical evacuation along the same route.

source_text: Ginabayan ng MASCAS procedures ang triage nang magpakilala ang exercise ng sabay-sabay na injuries mula sa bridge collapse at flooding.
target_text: MASCAS procedures guided triage when the exercise introduced simultaneous injuries from a bridge collapse and flooding.

source_text: Pinahintulutan ng Mutual Recognition ang coordination team na magtiwala sa certified rescue capabilities habang lokal pa rin ang mission assignment.
target_text: Mutual Recognition allowed the coordination team to trust certified rescue capabilities while still assigning missions locally.

source_text: Kinailangan ng APOD reception team ng mas malinaw na signage upang mabilis mahanap ng arriving responders ang registration, briefing, at transport areas.
target_text: The APOD reception team needed clearer signage so arriving responders could find registration, briefing, and transport areas quickly.

source_text: Pinilit ng SPOD delays ang LCC na unahin kung aling heavy cargo ang mauunang gumalaw kapag muling nagbukas ang berth.
target_text: SPOD delays forced the LCC to prioritize which heavy cargo should move first once the berth reopened.

source_text: Nanatiling vulnerable ang MSR dahil maaaring muling magsara ang isang steep section kung paluluwagin ng ulan ang slope.
target_text: The MSR remained vulnerable because one steep section could close again if rain loosened the slope.

source_text: Nakipag-ugnayan ang CIQ officers sa NFP upang iproseso ang approved relief personnel nang hindi naaantala ang urgent teams.
target_text: CIQ officers coordinated with the NFP to process approved relief personnel without delaying urgent teams.

source_text: Nirepaso ang MCDA support laban sa humanitarian need, civilian capacity, at malamang na duration ng gap.
target_text: MCDA support was reviewed against humanitarian need, civilian capacity, and the likely duration of the gap.

source_text: Nakatulong ang HuMOCC guidance na maiwasan ang misunderstandings nang dumalo ang military planners sa humanitarian coordination meetings.
target_text: HuMOCC guidance helped prevent misunderstandings when military planners attended humanitarian coordination meetings.

source_text: Humiling ang DVI teams ng interpreters upang maisagawa nang tumpak at may respeto ang family interviews.
target_text: DVI teams requested interpreters so family interviews could be conducted accurately and respectfully.

source_text: Iniulat ng LEMA na nagbukas ang village volunteers ng bagong shelter na wala pa sa national records.
target_text: LEMA reported that village volunteers had opened a new shelter not yet listed in national records.

source_text: Nagdagdag ang Ex COORES controllers ng fuel shortage inject upang subukan ang logistics prioritization at partner coordination.
target_text: Ex COORES controllers added a fuel shortage inject to test logistics prioritization and partner coordination.

source_text: Ipinakita ng TTX na kailangan ng participants ng mas malinaw na proseso para isara ang requests na hindi na relevant.
target_text: The TTX showed that participants needed a clearer process for closing requests that were no longer relevant.

source_text: Tumulong ang OPERA CIS na subaybayan kung ang mga alok ay naghihintay pa rin ng pag-apruba ng bansang tumatanggap o handa na para italaga sa gawain.
target_text: OPERA CIS helped track whether offers were still pending host-nation approval or ready for tasking.

source_text: Nakatulong ang SASOP references na ihanay ng team ang ASEAN support procedures sa national request process ng affected state.
target_text: SASOP references helped the team align ASEAN support procedures with the affected state's national request process.

source_text: Binanggit ang SASOP Chapter VI sa talakayan kung paano dapat maiproseso sa pagpasok ang kagamitang militar at makapunta sa mga nakatalagang gawain.
target_text: SASOP Chapter VI was cited when discussing how military equipment should clear entry and move to assigned tasks.

source_text: Pinatibay ng mga prinsipyo ng AADMER na dapat suportahan ng panrehiyong tulong ang pambansang pamumuno at palakasin ang kooperasyon sa pagitan ng mga kasaping estado.
target_text: AADMER principles reinforced that regional assistance should support national leadership and strengthen cooperation among member states.

source_text: Nakatulong ang karanasan sa ARDEX sa koponan ng ehersisyo na magdisenyo ng makatotohanang paglipat mula sa mga operasyon ng pagtugon patungo sa pagpaplano ng maagang pagbawi.
target_text: ARDEX experience helped the exercise team design realistic transitions from response operations to early recovery planning.

source_text: Inirekomenda ng SME sa pamamahala ng impormasyon ang simpleng sistema ng triage ng ulat para sa mga panahon ng sakunang mataas ang dami ng ulat.
target_text: The SME on information management recommended a simple report triage system for high-volume disaster periods.

source_text: Binigyang-diin ng mga talakayan sa AAR ang pangangailangan ng mas maiikling briefing, mas malinaw na mga may pananagutan sa gawain, at mas mahusay na pagsubaybay sa mga desisyon.
target_text: AAR discussions highlighted the need for shorter briefings, clearer task owners, and better tracking of decisions.

source_text: Sinuportahan ng GenAI ang triage ng pagsasalin sa pamamagitan ng pagtukoy ng mga ulat na kailangan ng agarang pagsusuri ng tao bago ipalaganap.
target_text: GenAI supported translation triage by identifying reports that needed urgent human review before dissemination.

source_text: Nag-draft ang LLM ng summary ng shelter reports, ngunit inalis ng information manager ang uncertain numbers bago release.
target_text: The LLM drafted a summary of shelter reports, but the information manager removed uncertain numbers before release.

source_text: Nakatulong ang datos ng Sentinel-1 sa mga tagaplano na tukuyin ang mga binahang bahagi ng kalsada na nakatago sa ilalim ng takip ng ulap sa optikal na imagery.
target_text: Sentinel-1 data helped planners identify flooded road segments hidden beneath cloud cover in optical imagery.

source_text: Sinuportahan ng Copernicus mapping ang paghahambing ng official district reports sa independent remote-sensing observations.
target_text: Copernicus mapping supported the comparison of official district reports with independent remote-sensing observations.

source_text: Ipinakita ng Digital Twin na maaaring mapahusay ng paglipat ng isang logistics hub na mas malapit sa baybayin ang delivery timing.
target_text: The Digital Twin showed that moving one logistics hub closer to the coast could improve delivery timing.

source_text: Pinahintulutan ng Hybrid Exercise ang remote planners na subukan ang policy decisions habang nagsasanay ang field teams sa cargo reception.
target_text: The Hybrid Exercise allowed remote planners to test policy decisions while field teams practiced cargo reception.

source_text: Bumuti ang Interoperability matapos maglathala ang information team ng maikling guide tungkol sa place names at data formats.
target_text: Interoperability improved after the information team published a short guide on place names and data formats.

source_text: Nabawasan ang Information Overload nang magsumite ang bawat cell ng decisions needed, major changes, at critical constraints lamang.
target_text: Information Overload was reduced when each cell submitted only decisions needed, major changes, and critical constraints.

source_text: Nilinaw ng ToR na dapat magbahagi ng information ang liaison officers, hindi independently mag-task ng assets sa labas ng approved channels.
target_text: The ToR clarified that liaison officers should share information, not independently task assets outside approved channels.

source_text: Kasama sa CONOPS development ang branch plans para sa port closure, airfield congestion, hospital surge, at renewed flooding.
target_text: CONOPS development included branch plans for port closure, airfield congestion, hospital surge, and renewed flooding.

source_text: Ipinaalam ng NFP sa regional network na kailangan ng revised arrival times ang dalawang accepted offers.
target_text: The NFP informed the regional network that two accepted offers needed revised arrival times.

source_text: Ginamit ng planning cell ang HADR upang magpasya kung kailangan ng industrial estate na nasira ng baha ng balanseng tala ng prayoridad ng sektor.
target_text: The planning cell used HADR to decide whether the flood-damaged industrial estate needed a balanced sector priority note.

source_text: Tumulong ang Changi RHCC dashboard na ipakita kung aling partner capabilities ang maaaring dumating sa loob ng susunod na dalawampu't apat na oras.
target_text: The Changi RHCC dashboard helped show which partner capabilities could arrive within the next twenty-four hours.

source_text: Isinaalang-alang lamang ang US INDOPACOM aircraft support matapos matasa na kulang ang road at sea options.
target_text: US INDOPACOM aircraft support was considered only after road and sea options were assessed as insufficient.

source_text: Inirekomenda ng CFE-DM observers na i-record ng coordination cell kung bakit ginawa ang bawat major operational choice.
target_text: CFE-DM observers recommended that the coordination cell record why each major operational choice was made.

source_text: Tumulong ang AHA Centre na ihanay ang regional support messaging upang hindi magpadala ang partners ng conflicting information sa affected state.
target_text: The AHA Centre helped align regional support messaging so partners did not send conflicting information to the affected state.

source_text: Sinuportahan ng UN OCHA ang humanitarian priorities discussion na naghihiwalay ng immediate life-saving needs mula sa early recovery concerns.
target_text: UN OCHA supported a humanitarian priorities discussion that separated immediate life-saving needs from early recovery concerns.

source_text: Nakatulong ang ASEAN-ERAT assessment data sa NDMO na pinuhin kung aling communes ang kailangan ng additional verification.
target_text: ASEAN-ERAT assessment data helped the NDMO refine which communes needed additional verification.

source_text: Tinulungan ng ACMC facilitators ang participants na magsanay magpaliwanag ng military support options sa civilian decision-makers sa plain language.
target_text: ACMC facilitators helped participants practice explaining military support options to civilian decision-makers in plain language.

source_text: Nakatulong ang PDC exposure maps na unahin ang warning messages para sa communities malapit sa rivers, steep slopes, at damaged roads.
target_text: PDC exposure maps helped prioritize warning messages for communities near rivers, steep slopes, and damaged roads.

source_text: Pinayuhan ng WHO ang health partners na isama ang mental health at psychosocial support sa shelter outreach plans.
target_text: WHO advised health partners to include mental health and psychosocial support in shelter outreach plans.

source_text: Nagplano ang WFP ng contingency food deliveries para sa communities na maaaring ma-cut off kung magsara muli ang MSR.
target_text: WFP planned contingency food deliveries for communities that could be cut off if the MSR closed again.

source_text: Hiniling ng ISCG sa partners na i-update ang beneficiary estimates bago magrekomenda ng expansion ng shelter assistance.
target_text: The ISCG asked partners to update beneficiary estimates before recommending an expansion of shelter assistance.

source_text: Nakipag-ugnayan ang USAID BHA sa ibang donors upang maiwasan ang funding ng overlapping activities sa parehong evacuation centres.
target_text: USAID BHA coordinated with other donors to avoid funding overlapping activities in the same evacuation centres.

source_text: Binigyang-diin ng ADMM-Plus discussions ang practical interoperability sa pagitan ng defence forces sa disaster response, hindi lamang strategic dialogue.
target_text: ADMM-Plus discussions emphasized practical interoperability between defence forces during disaster response, not only strategic dialogue.

source_text: Tinukoy ng EWG on HADR ang liaison training bilang paulit-ulit na pangangailangan sa maraming regional exercises.
target_text: The EWG on HADR identified liaison training as a recurring need across multiple regional exercises.

source_text: Nakatulong ang INSARAG coordination sa host nation na hatiin ang rescue work sa pagitan ng teams na may light, medium, at heavy capabilities.
target_text: INSARAG coordination helped the host nation divide rescue work between teams with light, medium, and heavy capabilities.

source_text: Ibinahagi ng ASEAN Secretariat ang pangwakas na buod ng pulong sa mga kasaping estado at mga tagamasid ng ehersisyo.
target_text: The ASEAN Secretariat shared the final meeting summary with member states and exercise observers.

source_text: Inihambing ng AMRG on HADR members kung gaano kabilis maide-deploy ang iba't ibang force packages pagkatapos ng official request.
target_text: AMRG on HADR members compared how quickly different force packages could deploy after official request.

source_text: Nagpayo ang SAF personnel tungkol sa safe cargo flow kapag magkakasalo ang forklifts, buses, medical teams, at aircraft sa limitadong apron space.
target_text: SAF personnel advised on safe cargo flow when forklifts, buses, medical teams, and aircraft shared limited apron space.

source_text: Inikoordina ang PLA support sa pamamagitan ng MNCC upang manatiling aligned ang engineering tasks sa national priorities.
target_text: PLA support was coordinated through the MNCC so engineering tasks remained aligned with national priorities.

source_text: Pinanatili ng JOCCA ang regional assistance matrix na nagpapakita ng offers, tasking status, at remaining coordination gaps.
target_text: JOCCA maintained a regional assistance matrix that showed offers, tasking status, and remaining coordination gaps.

source_text: Binigyang-diin ng SCDF rescue leaders ang kahalagahan ng fatigue management sa extended search operations.
target_text: SCDF rescue leaders stressed the importance of fatigue management during extended search operations.

source_text: Kinumpirma ng VINASARCOM na dapat iulat ng provincial authorities ang needs sa pamamagitan ng national channels sa halip na direktang humiling ng foreign teams.
target_text: VINASARCOM confirmed that provincial authorities should report needs through national channels rather than directly requesting foreign teams.

source_text: Ipinakita ng VDDMA river monitoring na mas huling aabot sa downstream districts ang flood peaks kaysa unang inaasahan.
target_text: VDDMA river monitoring showed that flood peaks would reach downstream districts later than originally expected.

source_text: Nakatulong ang VPA support na muling buksan ang road segment na nag-uugnay sa dalawang evacuation centres at pinakamalapit na ospital.
target_text: VPA support helped reopen a road segment that connected two evacuation centres with the nearest hospital.

source_text: Pinayuhan ng MARD na dapat isaalang-alang ng relief planning ang farmers na nawalan ng tools, seed, at livestock feed.
target_text: MARD advised that relief planning should account for farmers who lost tools, seed, and livestock feed.

source_text: Pinahintulutan ng MOT bridge updates ang convoy planners na ilipat ang heavy cargo sa mas ligtas na routes.
target_text: MOT bridge updates allowed convoy planners to shift heavy cargo onto safer routes.

source_text: Nakipag-ugnayan ang MOH sa VAMS upang ihambing ang hospital capacity reports sa ambulance transfer data.
target_text: MOH coordinated with VAMS to compare hospital capacity reports with ambulance transfer data.

source_text: Inirekomenda ng DRRP partners na palakasin ang community disaster committees batay sa gaps na inilantad ng scenario.
target_text: DRRP partners recommended strengthening community disaster committees based on gaps revealed by the scenario.

source_text: Nakatulong ang QPT funding na mapanatili ang local evacuation equipment na ginamit bago dumating ang outside assistance.
target_text: QPT funding helped maintain local evacuation equipment that was used before outside assistance arrived.

source_text: Tinukoy ng VNRC volunteers ang households na nangangailangan ng replacement documents, family tracing support, at basic relief items.
target_text: VNRC volunteers identified households needing replacement documents, family tracing support, and basic relief items.

source_text: Nagbahagi ang VAMS ng hospital surge summary bago ang final coordination meeting ng exercise.
target_text: VAMS shared a hospital surge summary before the final coordination meeting of the exercise.

source_text: Tumulong ang WoG coordination sa leaders na iugnay ang emergency decisions sa recovery planning para sa transport, agriculture, at public health.
target_text: WoG coordination helped leaders connect emergency decisions with recovery planning for transport, agriculture, and public health.

source_text: Isinara ng NDMO ang huling pending request matapos kumpirmahin na hindi na kailangan ng provincial authorities ng karagdagang external support.
target_text: The NDMO closed the last pending request after confirming that provincial authorities no longer required additional external support.

source_text: Idinokumento ng CMCoord staff ang lessons kung paano humiling ng military capabilities nang hindi ginagambala ang humanitarian coordination systems.
target_text: CMCoord staff documented lessons on how to request military capabilities without disrupting humanitarian coordination systems.

source_text: In-update ng NFP ang partners na tinanggap ng affected state ang water treatment support ngunit tinanggihan ang karagdagang rescue teams.
target_text: The NFP updated partners that the affected state had accepted water treatment support but declined additional rescue teams.

source_text: Nakatulong ang maikling pagsusuri ng Capacity Building [Mga pagsisikap na palakasin ang kakayahan ng stakeholder sa pagtugon] sa radio operators na bigyang-kahulugan ang bugso ng ulan sa gabi nang hindi naaantala ang inayos na listahan ng prayoridad.
target_text: A short review of Capacity Building [Efforts to strengthen stakeholder response ability] helped radio operators interpret a night-time rainfall surge without delaying a corrected priority list.
